199003.description:
1. Hakaba no Sore kara (墓場のそれから); COMITIA147
2. Bokura wa Piano de Tsunagatte Iru (僕らはピアノで繋がっている); Hokkaido COMITIA17
3. Shinanai Boku no Saikyou ni Kakkoii Shinikata (死なない僕の最強にカッコイイ死に方)

199004.description:
It's normal to be short, have a low education, have a low income, and be unpopular. The struggles of the socially disadvantaged are often the subject of jokes, but is it really okay to just laugh it off? A bittersweet ode to middle age, dedicated to adults who feel like they don't belong anywhere!

(Source: Cycomics, translated)
synonyms: Weak Man: Me and my Bullying Wife

199010.description:
Taeryang wakes up in a world where men are treated as commodities. Could the power of his "thrust" be enough to save him?

(Source: Toomics)

199011.description:
Mizushima, a yakuza, was fascinated by a Maitreya Buddha statue as a boy and developed a nasty habit of lusting only for non-human things. One night, Mizushima encounters a mermaid in the dark sea. Mizushima cannot forget the bewitchingly beautiful mermaid... He becomes entangled with the innocent "monster" and falls into a bottomless swamp of love...

(Source: Shinkosha, translated)

199012.description:
Noma and Sagara have known each other for ten years and have been sharing an apartment for one. Both gay and completely comfortable around each other, their living arrangement was supposed to be temporary, just until Noma found a boyfriend and moved out. But that never happened. Life with Sagara is easy, and Noma's slowly losing the will to leave. One day, while wondering if he could keep living like this, a thought hits him:

"What if we just... dated?"

Unsure if he can truly feel that way about Sagara, Noma acts on impulse and leans in for a kiss, only to receive one far more passionate in return...!?

(Source: Kaiohsha, translated)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

title.native: ジョーク・スタート・ルームメイト

199013.description:
Kashiwagi, who keeps shady ties with the yakuza, is invited out for some fun by Tatsumi, an executive at the office, and ends up at a drag bar. Though not in the mood, Kashiwagi finds himself intrigued by Mei, Tatsumi's favorite at the bar. After closing time, Kashiwagi waits outside for Mei, only to realize they are Koikawa, the classmate he once bullied in high school.

(Source: LEED Publishing, translated)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

title.native: さよなら、あの日の服従

199014.description:
Da-in, ended up possessing the villain of a story. To make Stardust—the story's protagonist and his favorite character in a dystopian manga—happy, he resolves to become the villain Egoistic for her growth. Da-in deliberately causes terror to enhance Stardust's abilities and preemptively prevents all the tragic events from the original story, but in the process, he gains public support while also drawing Stardust's suspicion. Stardust, who initially opposed him, gradually opens her heart, and soon even begins to show signs of obsession toward him...?

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)
synonyms: I Became the Villain the Hero Is Obsessed With
I Became the Villain the Hero Obsesses Over

199016.description:
Tokumoto is admired at work for his serious and reliable nature, but he has a secret. He likes to play with himself using adult toys. In his late twenties, still a virgin, with a well-trained body but no practical experience, the idea of finding a boyfriend feels like too much trouble. That is, until the friendly and outgoing younger coworker Kayama catches him shopping for toys. Before Tokumoto can recover from the embarrassment, Kayama suddenly asks him, "Can’t I be your partner?"

(Source: Kaiohsha, translated)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.
synonyms: The secret should be exposed and loved

title.native: ひみつは晒して愛でるべき

synonyms: The Cat Detective and the Stray

title.native: ナチュラル・コンプレックス

199020.description:
Quarter, a demon fascinated by human food, ends up possessing a poor human by accident?! Stripped of all his powers and trapped in the body of Go Sunmu, the demon finds that the life of a “low-grade” human is even worse than life in hell, and thus resolves to become a “high-grade” human instead. Meanwhile, Sunho Group, the country’s top conglomerate, opens a special recruitment drive for new employees, disregarding education and work experience. The demon joins as a low-level worker in the company’s food division… What will this demon-turned-office worker gain, and what kind of influence will he have on the humans around him?

“When thinking like a human doesn’t give you the answer, act like a demon. The company will like it even more!”

A fantasy drama that sharply and wittily digs into the absurdities of the world!

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)
synonyms: HELL TEMPLE～地獄から人間界へ～

199021.description:
After nine failed blind date, Wanwan Mo suffered from the phobia of blind date, and the tenth one directly leads to a flash marriage. Before their marriage, Wanwan Mo said that my annual salary was 300,000, you can rely on me after we married. After the marriage, Yanting Mo got the invoice of his custom handmade business suit to apply for reimbursement. But that business suit was equal to her annual salary! The man used his deep voice and appeared in the dark, my dear, didn’t you promise to afford me? Wanwan Mo was angry and wanted to divorce after a year... Hmm...

"Hehe, how could you divorce me when you are unable to afford me?"

(Source: WebComics)

199022.description:
After Mu Wei'er was rescued from a drowning accident in the ocean, she realized she had lost her memory. Soon she was told by someone claiming to be her mother that she was getting engaged to Ji Chenfeng – a prominent military commander who refused to attend his own engagement party. But Mu Wei'er was not a pushover. She soon decided that a puppy would be present instead of Ji Chenfeng at the party...

(Source: WebComics)

199027.description:
Yeonu's relationship was supposed to be different, but reality had crueler plans. After finding out her husband of ten years has been cheating on her, all she has on her mind now is revenge. Of course, she can't just sleep with anybody to pay him back, so she resolves to target someone who will hurt him the most. And who better than her husband's perfect boss?

(Source: Tapas)

Note: Part of Metatoon's Yongmang Danpyeonseon (욕망 단편선) Collection.
synonyms: [욕망 단편선] 남편 상사와 하는 나쁜 짓
[Yongmang Danpyeonseon] Nampyeon Sangsawa Haneun Nappeun Jit
[Desire Anthology] Naughty Deeds with My Husband’s Boss

title.english: Doing Bad Things with My Husband's Boss

199028.description:
Seeking a way back to her world, Anna becomes a maid at the infamous "Swan's Grave." When the marquis mistakes her for his vanished wife and offers a forbidden bargain, Anna is drawn into the haunting legacy of the Lorengreen house.

(Source: Manta)

199030.description:
99-year-old virgin bat Insu Ban-Hwi, who couldn't get a companion because of his vanity, meets the rich and prickly Do Yu-Jin, will he be able to escape his virginity?

(Source: Bomtoon, translated)

199031.description: Note: Originally published in Comic Yuri-Hime November 2025 issue.

title.native: トウコ スイングバイ

199032.description: Note: Originally published in Galette Meets issue 6.

199033.description:
Franny was abandoned by her mother at the age of five and raised by her uncle. Now, ten years later, Franny learns that her mother is suffering from a serious disease and reluctantly agrees to meet her. Franny learns that love sometimes requires you to make painful choices. Will Franny be able to put the past behind her and accept the truth about her mother’s actions…?

(Source: SMA)

199034.description:
If only I could wear my favorite clothes however I want—

Natsuki Yonei, a first-year high school girl, thought about wearing slacks to school, but she ended up going with the "safe" option of a skirt instead. But there is one girl, Miwa Omi, who is wearing pants, even though all the other girls are wearing skirts. Intrigued, Natsuki tries to befriend her, and she learns the reason why Miwa doesn't wear skirts...

A first-love in uniform, a sparkling yet slightly bittersweet chapter of high school life.

(Source: Yuri Hime, translated)

title.native: 晴れた日のドレスコード

199035.description: Note: Originally published in Galette Meets issue 8.

title.native: キスより先にできること
title.romaji: Kiss yori Saki ni Dekiru Koto

199036.description:
Seol is a rising Go prodigy who built her career by memorizing every game she could find, but her play is empty. When she meets Sang-Hun, a self-taught player who defies all logic, her world begins to crack. To surpass the greatest player of her era and her own past, she must abandon everything she knows and step into the unknown. In a game with endless possibilities, can she create a move that’s truly her own?

(Source: WEBTOON)

199037.description: Note: Originally published in Galette Meets issue 5.
synonyms: If We Were to Put a Name to This Stagnant Relationship

title.native: この不毛な関係に名前を付けるなら
title.romaji: Kono Fumouna Kankei ni Namae wo Tsukeru nara

199038.description:
The maid cafe that Akiho frequents has a secret "password" that no other cafe has. What happens when you tell your preferred maid, Luna, "XXXXX"...?! A yuri comedy that will make your heart flutter with this heart-racing and mismatched couple♪ Winner of the Silver Prize in the Twitter Manga Monthly Awards "#Homebake"!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title.native: メイドさんと○○ごっこができるお店の話
title.romaji: Maid-san to ○○-gokko ga Dekiru wo Mise no Hanashi

199039.description:
Neglected and abused for killing her mother in childbirth, Patricia Alben leaves home at an early age to join the army, where she thrives thanks to her exceptional mana. There, she meets Theo, a bastard prince assigned to her unit. Pity turns into closeness as she trains him, until they’re sent on a suicide mission where Patricia is gravely injured saving Theo. Healed by Theo’s magic, she awakens as a child and is adopted by her former family. Meanwhile, Theo slaughters his own family and claims the throne…

(Source: WEBTOON)
synonyms: Le pouvoir de régénération a trop bien marché
Too Much Regeneration! Now the King Obsesses Over Me

title.english: His Recovery Magic Worked Too Well!
title.native: 再生魔法が効きすぎた! 人生やり直したら、王様になった元部下に溺愛されています
title.romaji: Saisei Mahou ga Kiki Sugita!: Jinsei Yarinaoshitara, Ousama ni Natta moto Buka ni Dekiai Sareteimasu

199040.description:
Modern-day culinary genius Ji-Yeong suddenly finds herself transported back to the Joseon Dynasty, trapped in the royal kitchens of the most notorious tyrant in history. To keep her head on her shoulders, she must satisfy the volatile cravings of King Yeon-San-- a man whose legendary temper is as sharp as the chef’s own knives. With political rivals plotting her downfall and a mad king watching her every move, can Ji-Yeong’s 21st-century recipes serve as her ultimate shield, or will her next meal be her last?

(Source: WEBTOON)
synonyms: Surviving as the Tyrant King’s Chef

199041.description:
Kei Sasazaki has secretly been in love with his university classmate and coworker, Yuuhi Tomita. Yuuhi may be the perfect, smart, and handsome guy in public, but at home he’s surprisingly hopeless at taking care of himself, and Kei secretly treasures being the one Yuuhi relies on. Kei has always wanted to confess someday, but for now he's content with just imagining it... or so he thought. One day, during a meal, he blurts out something that sounds like a confession! Sensing that Yuuhi is about to turn him down, Kei panics and tries to take it back, but that only leads to an unexpected turn of events―!?

(Source: Kaiohsha, translated)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

title.native: その件は無かったことに
title.romaji: Sono Ken wa Nakatta Koto ni

title.native: ナンバー9のセルフィッシュ

199045.description:
"We teach sex- Self Defense".

Seong-Hyeon is a Master of a failing Hapkido studio. One day, he acquires a mysterious program. It says his studio will become a success if he completes the quests. However, the quest is... [Quest] Make a female member cum.

(Source: TOPTOON, edited)
synonyms: I Will Teach You Self Defense
お触りから本番まで!?やれる護身術道場づくり

199046.description: One-shot published in Young Comic Special Issue 1973.

199048.description:
Sure, I was reborn as the villainess, but her life seemed like a hassle, so I chose peace. But even though I’m keeping my distance from the main plot, the sub male leads keep showing up on my doorstep. They all want the same thing: to share my bed! Whatever the reason, I don’t want to get involved… but how could I refuse?

(Source: Tapas)
synonyms: Sub Male Leads, Come to My Bed Right Now

title.english: Get In My Bed, Supporting Male Leads!

199049.description:
Upon waking up in a novel, Cheria Mayol is sold into marriage by her abusive family. Her betrothed is the main villain, Kivrin Nectarian, who has been locked up and declared a monster. But when Cheria sees how sweet and meek the boy is, she resolves to raise him into a good person. Using her wits and charm, she devises a plan to escape the manor where they are confined and wins the hearts of her new family. With her in-laws now on her side, can Cheria save Kivrin and find their happy ending?

(Source: Tapas)
synonyms: I Am The Evil Wife of a Young Husband
I Am the Evil Wife of Young Husband

199050.description:
What should I do with you? I could cut down the world with a single sword... but I cannot harm even a single hair on your head. Fierce warrior... Your passion and single-minded determination melt my heart, colder than the ice of a snowy country. What should I do... When you hate something, you even come to love it. Fierce warrior...

(Source: Mr.Blue, translated)

199051.description:
When stress builds up, I look for something refreshing. When nothing feels refreshing, I shout something that will clear my mind. "Bang ya! Bang ya!" I chose "Bang ya bang ya" as the title to experience that feeling.

(Source: Mr.Blue, translated)

199052.description:
Falling in love for the first time at age 600?!

Demon Queen Eligor is shaken out of her solitary life when she saves an alluring stranger, but she soon learns he is one of her sworn enemies — a human knight! Can her crush bloom into true romance, or is this love story doomed from the start?

(Source: Manta)

title.english: The Demon Queen Is in Love!

199053.description: Note: Originally published in Petit Galette issue 1.
synonyms: Visiting the Witch of the Forest

title.native: 森の魔女に会いに行く
title.romaji: Mori no Majo ni Ai ni Iku

title.native: シュレディンガーの告白

199057.description:
Mitrov, a young nobleman who was banished from his home because he was only interested in eating, became an adventurer and explored a labyrinth, but was cornered by a monster and his life came to an abrupt end...or so it seemed. But when an elf girl named Glacier rescued him from a predicament, he formed a party with her and set foot in a new world with his first companions...

(Source: Comic Gardo, translated)
synonyms: The Fat Noble Dances a Waltz in the Labyrinth

title.native: 太っちょ貴族は迷宮でワルツを踊る
title.romaji: Futoccho Kizoku wa Meikyuu de Waltz wo Odoru

synonyms: To Be Wrapped Up In The Night
All of This World is a Cat's Dream
Everything in this world is a cat's dream - Chocolate of Oblivion -

title.native: この世のすべては猫の夢- 忘却のチョコレート -
title.romaji: Konoyo no Subete wa Neko no Yume: Boukyaku no Chokoreito

199061.description:
That day, Tsutomu was driving as if he was running away from something. He stopped his car at a service area and vomited, when a strange woman offered him some water... She asked him to take her to a place where she could use the phone, and although he felt something was off, he reluctantly agreed... While in the car, he casually turned on the radio and heard news of a murder. The suspect's description matched the woman sitting in the back seat...

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

Note: Chapter count includes two extra chapters.

title.native: ナイト・リセット・キロポスト

199062.description:
"I should be in the hospital...?"

Se-Ri wakes up from a car accident to find herself a celebrity on the verge of retirement.

"What did I do? Why does everyone hate me!!!"

There are mountains of misunderstandings Se-Ri has to resolve. And Jeong-Min, who spent his childhood with Se-Ri, has become a successful actor in the entertainment industry. One day, Jeong-Min comes to her and suggests that they film a program together... Thanks to Jeong-Min's fame, the two of them keep rising in the real-time search rankings.

The relationship between us is familiar yet unfamiliar, close yet distant...?!

(Source: Comico, translated)

199063.description:
The story of Ho-Gu, a man who is generous to others but unkind to himself. After a reunion with a high school crush, Ho-Gu's daily life becomes increasingly entangled.

(Source: Comico, translated)

Note: Includes one prologue chapter.

199064.description:
“Ten years younger!”

[Special compensation will be paid that reflects the object's aspiration.]

A legendary hunter who was in retirement at the age of Palsun. I accidentally regained the power of fire and rejuvenated it, and returned to the hunter industry after a long time... In the Hunter industry... too many rotten ones?

(Source: Naver, translated)
synonyms: The Legendary Hunter Becomes Young Again

199065.description:
During their school days, Jae-Woo and Hyun-Min were each other's equal. Hyun-Min receives a special gift from Jae-Woo and is convinced that it's a green light for both of them. However, when Hyun-Min witnesses Jae-Woo giving the same gift to another girl, Hyun-Min becomes convinced that Jae-Woo is just a swallow who flirts with anyone and distances himself from him. Six years later, the two reunite at a class reunion, but Hyun-Min still feels uneasy about Jae-Woo. But...

"Senior. The last train has already left. Can you let me stay for just one day?"

What kind of shameless kid is this?

(Source: Lezhin, translated)

199067.description:
Yuki-onna, Zashiki-warashi, Tengu, Kappa, Okunai-sama—these are some of the various folk beliefs and legends recorded in "The Legends of Tono," a collection of folklore from the Tono region. The stories were narrated by Kizen Sasaki, a native of the Tono area, transcribed by Kunio Yanagita, and published after extensive local research.
This work, which condenses Japanese views on life, death, and nature, is also called "the origin of Japanese folklore studies." This daring comic adaptation intertwines and revives four supernatural tales: "Oshira-sama," "Kappa," "Fox," and "Futtachi," for a modern audience.

199070.description: In Japan, where explorers thrive in dungeon conquests, Namiki Haruka, despite reaching Level 100, remained weak in stats and was ridiculed as an early bloomer loser by society. However, triggered by his own death, he awakened the unique skill “Divine Measure” and began his transformation.
synonyms: Leveling Up Fast with Divine Measurement Skills
I Can Level Up Fast with My Divine Skill!

title.native: 神測スキルで最速レベリング
title.romaji: Kami Haka Skill de Saisoku Leveling

title.native: ちっちゃくてデカくて可愛い七瀬さんを勘違い元カレから奪って幸せにする
title.romaji: Chicchakute Dekakute Kawaii Nanase-san wo Kanchigai Motokare kara Ubatte Shiawase ni Suru

199072.description:
After a long battle with illness, Yuri passes away and is reincarnated into another world as per a pact with God.
Unable to move properly in bed, Yuri, who had always longed for a slow life, is given the bare minimum of abilities to survive in the other world and begins his second life as a boy named "Yuri."
Using the skills he has been given, he manages to create an environment for food, clothing, and shelter, but monsters are rampant in the other world, and every day is a life of crisis! One day, Yuri finds a spirit collapsed in the forest...

(Translated from BookWalker)

title.native: 転生者は世間知らず～特典スキルでスローライフ！？～ コミック版
title.romaji: Tenseisha wa Sekenshirazu: Tokuten Skill de Slow Life!? Comic-ban

199074.description:
"You named our daughter after your ex...?!"

Soko lives with her kind husband and three-year-old daughter. Although she may be busy, she's living happily everyday. There's only one thing she doesn't understand about her picture-perfect husband. Instead of wearing his wedding ring, he wears a memento ring for his late relative. But one day, Soko finds out her husband's secret, and feels there is a woman popping up behind the scenes.

"Am I imagining things? Or...is my husband actually having an affair?!"

What path will this marriage full of doubt and suspicion take...?!

(Source: MangaPlaza)

title.english: My Husband Wears a Ring on His Right Hand
title.romaji: Migite ni Yubiwa wo Suru Otto

199075.description:
Falling for the man with an obsessive love will...

Kasumi Kirishima is constantly asked by her coworkers to help them with their tasks and works overtime every day. She's too put together, which creates a rift between her and her boyfriend, Sota. One day, Kasumi finishes her work early, but when she gets home, she discovers Sota is cheating on her with her coworker, Ota! After having her world turned upside down, Kasumi pretends to be unaffected and runs out of their apartment. In the middle of her breakdown, the office heartthrob, Jun Kayanuma, comes to her rescue. At first, she doesn't know what to make of his frankness with her, but she gradually falls for him. However, there's more to Jun than meets the eye...

(Source: MangaPlaza)
199075.hashtag: #僕のことだけ見てればいいのに

title.english: I Wish You'd Only Look At Me
title.native: 僕のことだけ見てればいいのに
title.romaji: Boku no Koto Dake Mitereba Ii no ni

199076.description:
Caught in the gaze of his fierce, gorgeous eyes, it's impossible to move. It's become clear in every way imaginable... you are my...

"I've finally found you, my mate."

After Sasha's parents died in an accident, she has been under the care of her aunt and uncle working as a servant for them day in and day out. The only thing helping her carry on has been the day of her coming-of-age ceremony, where she will learn her magical affinity and be able to find a mate. If only she could find a kind mate, she could finally rid herself of this place. However, her aunt and uncle refuse to let her go, and insist on selling Sasha away to pay off debts. Just in the nick of time, Lord Volt Sednik comes to her aid.

(Source: MangaPlaza)
synonyms: 残虐公の可愛いつがい

title.english: The Cruel Lord's Adorable Mate: Offering Up My First Time to My Loving Husband
title.native: 残虐公の可愛いつがい 愛したがりな旦那様に初めてを捧げます
title.romaji: Zangyakukou no Kawaii Tsugai: Aishitagari na Danna-sama ni Hajimete wo Sasagemasu

199078.description:
Jin is an adventurer so overwhelmingly strong that he can cut down a three-headed dragon with a single slash! Though he craves more power, he fears that becoming any stronger would turn him into a monster... so he retires from adventuring and returns to his hometown café, in Dagar!

However, in the mountains behind his family home lies a dungeon said to grant one’s deepest desires...?!

Together with Shuna, a runaway saint who suddenly barges into his life, the power-hungry former adventurer sets out to conquer the dangerous, monster-filled dungeon! And after the battles, they savor exquisite dungeon cuisine made from the monsters they defeat—?!
synonyms: The Outcast Swordsman, Drawn to Power, Masters the Hidden Dungeon: Once Branded a Monster, the Former Adventurer Dominates in a Labyrinth Known Only to Him

title.native: 人外剣士は力に魅せられ裏迷宮を攻略す～化け物扱いされた元冒険者は、自分だけが知る迷宮で人目を気にせず無双する～
title.romaji: Jingai Kenshi wa Chikara ni Miserare Ura Meikyuu wo Kouryaku su: Bakemono Atsukai sareta Moto Boukensha wa, Jibun dake ga Shiru Meikyuu de Hitome wo Ki ni Sezu Musou suru

199079.description:
Niizato Gara, who runs a glass workshop inherited from his grandfather, falls into the sea while picking up discarded bottles. The last thing he sees before losing consciousness is a glittering, glass-like object... a mermaid!? Gara awakens in the arms of Ruri, a mysterious mermaid who came from a distant sea. They are immediately attracted to each other, but Ruri becomes excited when Gara touches his shiny scales...

(Source: Beltoon, translated)

title.native: 君の温度に染まる瑠璃～光る夜の雫～
title.romaji: Kimi no Ondo ni Somaru Ruri: Hikaru Yoru no Shizuku

199080.description:
From childhood, Jae-Woong harbored a twisted attachment to his half-brother, Jae-Young. While quenching his desires through art, painting his brother's face on canvas, he encounters Eun-Gang, who bears a striking resemblance to Jae-Young...

(Source: Lezhin, translated)

199081.description:
The largest-scale isekai work yet! An entire local factory is transported to another world. Veteran engineers working at a local factory use their technical skills and knowledge to conquer another world!? As the battle between the human army and the Demon King's army intensifies, the first site the engineers arrive at is the Demon King's castle's ultra-black weapons factory! To save the oppressed goblins, Japanese corporate warriors start a revolution!! The closest thing to God in this world is... an engineer! This is the beginning of a technology fantasy set in another world!

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

title.native: 異世界町工場無双 ～信頼と実績の異世界征服～
title.romaji: Isekai Machikouba Musou: Shinrai to Jisseki no Isekai Seifuku

199082.description:
Yeon-O, the owner of an ordinary gelato shop, has been having sleepless nights for days due to strange dreams about a mysterious man. Just as he begins to question his own sexual frustrations, he stumbles upon the owner of the shop, Ji-Hyeok, and realizes he's the same person from his dreams.

"I'm not good enough. Can I do more?"

(Source: Mr.Blue, translated)

199083.description:
From the weakest summoner to the world's greatest dragon knight! Adventurer Jay was ridiculed by those around him as the "Lizard Summoner." He was looked down upon because the only summonable beasts he could summon were small lizards. Because of this, Jay was unable to form a party with anyone, and continued his lonely adventures while doting on Kyuk... But one day, Kyuk suddenly grew into a gigantic, majestic dragon - Bahamut! Jay took this opportunity to start working as a courier, and before long, word of the "Courier Dragon Knight" spread throughout the royal capital, and everyone began relying on him! From a mocked F-rank summoner to the world's greatest dragon knight - the unrivaled fantasy life begins!!

(Source: Shueisha, translated)

title.native: Fランク召喚士、ペット扱いで可愛がっていた召喚獣がバハムートに成長したので冒険を辞めて最強の竜騎士になる
title.romaji: F-Rank Shoukanshi, Pet Atsukaide Kawaigatteita Shoukanju ga Bahamut ni Seichou shita node Bouken wo Yamete Saikyou no Ryuu Kishi ni naru

199084.description:
The year is 75 AD. In the ancient Roman Empire, a criminal - Aaron - is imprisoned in the amphitheater. Used not only for gladiator fights but also for the execution of criminals, the amphitheater was the most important entertainment facility for the citizens. However, Aaron, a "criminal who deserves to be killed," is burdened with a deeper sin than anyone else; he must never be killed, he must never die. This is the story of a man obsessed with revenge, and his continued resistance to his "fate." A stunningly drawn historical spectacle begins!!!

(Source: Nihon Bungeisha, translated)

title.native: エゴ・エリス－剣奴の血－

199085.description:
I never believed that my favorite idol was a incubus and was crazy about me (and my energy)!

The overly earnest virgin office lady, Fuka, lives for the sole purpose of supporting her favorite idol, Ichijoji Ruka. One day, she is suddenly kidnapped by a mysterious man and forced to do naughty things. To her surprise, the man's true identity is her favorite idol, Ruka. Ruka is actually not human, but a incubus, and they end up doing "pleasant things" in a relationship, hoping to get the ultimate orgasmic energy that Fuka gives off, but...

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title.native: えっちなのはわたしのせいじゃありません　～処女なのに年下アイドルの求愛が重すぎます！～
title.romaji: Ecchi na no wa Watashi no Sei ja Arimasen: Shojo nanoni Toshishita Idol no Kyuuai ga Omo Sugimasu!

199086.description:
Tae-Young, Ji-Won's adorable younger brother who used to follow him around as a child, has grown into a wonderful adult when he meets him after seven years. The joy is fleeting, as the relationship sheds after mistaking Ji-Won for a one-night stand reveals the shell of a longtime childhood friend. Ji-Won is confused by the changing nature of his relationship with Tae-Young. To make matters worse, he encounters Seon-Ha, whom he met in a class he failed to register for, "Theory of Love," and ends up having a one-night stand while drunk. Ji-Won, overcome with a mental breakdown, wonders if he's really that vulnerable to pleasure, but their relationship takes an unexpected turn...

(Source: Mr.Blue, translated)

Note: Includes three extra chapters.
synonyms: Love Theory ทฤษฎีรักแผลงฤทธิ์

199087.description:
Guide Raven meets Esper Eve. It's clear they're meeting for the first time, but this man seems to know him far too well. He doesn't need to know every little thing about him: his habits, his unconscious behaviors, even his sexual preferences. Raven can't afford to distance himself, for fear of the potential repercussions if his precious body falls ill. Their awkward, uncomfortable partnership continues.

(Source: Lezhin, translated)

199089.description:
Every month, Suyeong’s mother receives one million won—money bound to a life-saving debt from years ago. After losing contact with the family behind it, Suyeong goes on with her life, unaware of how closely their paths will soon cross again. Transferred to a newly formed content team, she meets her new manager, Tae-eun—the same man she once saw publicly disgraced months earlier. Bound by an unspoken past and a debt neither of them chose, they keep their distance. But how long can that last?

(Source: WEBTOON)

199090.description:
After his decisive battle with the Hero, the Demon King gained human emotions. Because of those emotions, he lost everything, but through a fateful encounter, he met a girl. Stella, an ordinary student at the Magic Department with average grades...

Isn't she a sloppy, reckless brat? I should make this fool of a person...!

(Source: Naver, translated)

199091.description:
Luka is bullied at school because of his background. The only friend he has is Ian, his dorm roommate. Each time Ian steps in to help, Luka can’t help feeling helpless. One Monday, he skips class and sneaks into an abandoned library, only to find someone already there. The boy introduces himself as Oliver and soon becomes someone who truly understands him. But there's one problem, Luka is the only one who can see him...

(Source: LEED Publishing, translated)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

title.native: ブルーマンデイ スペクター

199092.description:
An antique store in Nishiogikubo called “Kujyuku Shoten”. There lives a man, Fumi, who can no longer trust anyone because he was once betrayed by someone, and a mysterious boy, Mashiro. Mashiro is in fact a mourning god for the “water drop” stationery, and with his “ability to see the ‘memories’ of antiques,” the two solve the problems of people who come to the store. Today, too, the store receives items that have “something to say” about them.

Welcome to the slightly mysterious and heartwarming world of antiques.

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

synonyms: Hear the echoes of his solitude

199094.description:
A selection of Hell Camp short stories produced by legendary writers Lee Hyeon-Se and Lee Du-Ho! Discover the powerful debuts of 24 of the strongest rookies of 2025!

(Source: Naver, translated)

Stories Included:
1. Drop the Outsider (드랍 더 아웃사이더) [Ju-Won Lee]

199095.description:
Sandra, a strict maid, has focused solely on her work and is now at an age where she is considered too old to get married, so she has given up on love and marriage. Everyone around her thinks she is far from ready for marriage, but she actually has feelings for Ian, the vice-commander of the Knights. One day, her younger brother Julius, the youngest member of the Knights' elite unit, asks her to pretend to be his lover to keep away from women. Sandra reluctantly accepts, but Ian sees her pretending to be Julius' lover...! After that, for some reason, Ian cuts his long bangs, shaves his beard, and dresses up in a completely different way...!? And what's more, Sandra receives a marriage proposal from a new man...!?

The love story of a clumsy knight and a strict maid begins!

(Source: Shueisha, translated)

title.native: ド真面目侍女の婚約騒動! ～無口な騎士団副団長に実はベタ惚れされてました～
title.romaji: Do Majime Jijo no Konyaku Soudou!: Mukuchina Kishidan Fukudanchou ni Jitsu wa Betabore Saretemashita

199096.description:
Just another day relaxing and having sex with his girlfriend… and her sister!?

(Source: Irodori Comics)

title.english: Fuck Buddies With His Girlfriend's Sister
title.native: 彼女の妹をセフレにした話
title.romaji: Kanojo no Imouto wo SeFri ni Shita Hanashi

199097.description:
Soyu Yang is better than you and he knows it. Even in his dreams, he is the chosen one. A martial arts grand master, Yukgwan, speaks to him in a dream and brings him into a parallel world with superhuman abilities and “errors,” mutations that turn you into a monster. One of these errors is a former disciple of Yukgwan, now a dragon, and terrorizing the parallel world. Soyu and Kara, his anti-romantic partner, are chosen to hunt the dragon, but Soyu meets another who says he’s the fake version of him…

(Source: WEBTOON)
synonyms: The Zero Chronicles of the Nine Dreams

199098.description:
As the only witch in this world, Lupia is gifted with the magical ability to take the injuries and illnesses of another and transfer them to herself—a secret she keeps to herself. She marries her first love, King Felix, and is deeply devoted to him, and the affection seems mutual. Unfortunately, due to a misunderstanding, Felix believes that she has betrayed him and begins to treat her coldly. After Lupia sacrifices herself to save Felix’s life, she falls into a deep sleep. Thus begins the story of a long and unrequited love, and a husband’s desperate devotion to his wife.

"Although you may forget your feelings for me, I shall always love you, and I will be sure to bring you back."

(Source: Manga UP!)
synonyms: The self-sacrificing witch is misunderstood by the king and is given his first and last love

title.english: The Sacrificial Witch and the Lovelorn King
title.native: 誤解された『身代わりの魔女』は、国王から最初の恋と最後の恋を捧げられる
title.romaji: Gokai sareta "Migawari no Majo" wa, Kokuou kara Saisho no Koi to Saigo no Koi wo Sasagerareru

199100.description: Note: A live-action AV adaptation (MUDR-297) was released on March 14th, 2025.

title.native: 旅先で仲良くなった子が男と思ってたら女の子だった件!!EX
title.romaji: Tabisaki de Nakayoku Natta Ko ga Otoko to Omottetara Onnanoko datta Ken!! EX

synonyms: Am I Being ... by a Boy from our Class?

title.romaji: Watashi wa Class no Danshi ni...

199102.description: Two part story serialized in ZERO Vols 10-11

199103.description:
A surreal one shot by prolific children's book illustrator Yousuke Inoue.

Note: Published in COM Magazine 1969-07

199104.description:
“What was going through your mind?”

Ye-Rim Han was an ordinary student who loved filming until one day, she started hearing the thoughts of anyone captured in a photo or video. However, this ability brings her nothing but torment as she attempts to navigate her film and video production program without being overwhelmed by everyone’s thoughts. Soon after, Ye-Rim meets Jin-Ho Cha, a performing arts student who confides in her about his own ability. As the two work together to overcome their shared aversion to being in front of and behind the camera, they find themselves falling for each other.

(Source: WEBTOON)
synonyms: ถอดรหัสเสียงรักในใจ
聞こえるふたりの秘密同盟

199105.description:
Jipil is a recently divorced man with no major flaws, just a few lingering emotional bruises. One night, after drinking a bit too much, he picks up a stray cat on the street and brings it home. But the next morning, the creature in his bed is not a cat at all. It is Myohyeon, a runaway catgirl with ears, a tail, and her own share of complicated circumstances. Memories of the “dream” he thought he had, the night he spent with her, suddenly come rushing back. Myohyeon insists he take responsibility and let her stay with him. Before Jipil can even argue, his friend shows up at the door. Panicked, Jipil introduces Myohyeon, in her cat form, as the pet he is raising. And just like that, living together becomes unavoidable. With a few ground rules set, the two begin an awkward but strangely sweet cohabitation. Can they follow the rules and keep life peaceful, or will the unexpected feelings between them break every boundary?

(Source: Lezhin US)

synonyms: Lonely Haruki-kun Just Wants a Friend

title.native: ともだちが欲しい春生くん
ここで一緒に暮らそうよ
title.romaji: Koko de Issho ni Kurasou yo

199109.description:
Haruto, a high school senior, was secretly in love with his tutor, Chigaya-sensei. He mustered all of his courage and confessed, only to be rejected. To make matters worse, Chigaya quit tutoring soon after. Haruto buried the bitter memory deep in his heart but remembered one thing Chigaya said: "I like stylish people." Using that as motivation, he got a makeover for his big college debut. But on campus, he unexpectedly runs into Chigaya again! As Haruto spends more time with the man he used to think was flawless, he discovers Chigaya's unexpectedly clumsy and adorable side. He knows this love can't come true, and yet...! "Sensei, you're so unfair! The more I see you, the more I want to know everything about you..."

(Source: Futabasha, translated)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

title.native: 先生、俺のこと好きになってよ。
title.romaji: Sensei, Ore no Koto Suki ni Natte yo.

199110.description:
Suenaga, a university student, has lost confidence in dealing with people because of past trauma. Encouraged by the words of Koba, a senior he meets at a theater club performance, Suenaga decides to join the club. Unlike Suenaga, who hides his true self and goes along with those around him, he finds himself drawn to Koba who's quiet, sincere, and kind. One night, when the two go out drinking together, a slightly tipsy Koba makes a startling confession...

(Source: Kaiohsha, translated)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

title.native: 君と僕のプラトニック

199114.description:
Regret! Love that hasn't started yet! A room sharing romantic comedy!

When they were young, a man and a woman who were childhood friends who promised to get married if they were single even at the age of 30. And so the two of them, who turned 29, had no choice but to start living together.
They argued over which fabric softener to use, and how many eggs to buy... Even if there is love, it is difficult to live together. Not to mention how difficult it is when there is no love...!

(Source: Shogakukan, translated)

199115.description:
When a prophetic dream shows her future stepfather killing her family, Emeline Wedgewood sets out to stop her mother's marriage to the duke at all costs. And what better way than to start a scandal with the duke's son, Eric Orleans? Suspicious of his father's intentions, Eric proposes that he and Emeline marry so their parents can't. But will the scandal of the century be enough to foil the duke's plans? Or will their sham marriage pit these unlikely allies into greater danger than ever before?

(Source: Tapas)
synonyms: It Turned Out to be a Useful Fraudulent Marriage

199116.description:
Brave New World is a virtual reality MMORPG with the most expansive world in gaming history--one big enough that its users can earn a living in it. Looking to earn some cash, Tae-Sung Han pours his heart and soul into playing, even becoming master of a strong guild. All is well until a rival guild, Genesis, annihilates them and hunts Tae-Sung down. On the verge of getting caught, a mysterious old man rescues Tae-Sung and presents a new way forward...

(Source: Tapas)

199117.description:
If you're born with an ugly face, you have to know where to fit in and where to leave out, and be able to discern what's acceptable and what's not. Noeul considered himself fortunate to have been born with that kind of discernment.

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)
synonyms: You Expect Anyone to Like You with That Face?

199119.description:
A drug eradication message from artists Song Ga & Eunso!

This content is a brand webtoon from the Ministry of Food and Drug Safety, and is a drug prevention campaign delivered by artists Song Ga & Eunso.

(Source: Naver, translated)

199120.description:
An unexpected encounter brings together Yuuki Sanada, an ordinary commoner, and Junna Tenkouin, a high-society young lady trapped in a restrictive lifestyle. Almost instantly, Yuuki finds himself deeply drawn to Junna, resolving to help her fulfill every dream she’s been forced to hold back. Despite the gap in their social status, these two young lovebirds are determined to fight for their happy ending!

(Source: Manga UP!)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.
synonyms: 100 Things the Sheltered Lady and This Commoner Want to Do

title.english: 100 Things the Sheltered Lady and This Commoner Want to Do
title.native: 箱入りお嬢様と庶民な俺のやりたい100のこと
title.romaji: Hakoiri Ojousama to Shomin na Ore no Yaritai 100 no koto

199121.description:
Kang Su-Ho, the leader of Sales Team 2, who was usually considered unlucky, was suddenly transferred to lead Sales Team 1. While the two of them were uncomfortably working overtime, Team Leader Kang approached him and asked:

"Is that what Manager Yang said?"
"What, what?"
"I mean, the rumor that I have erectile dysfunction."

Before he could even refute it, Manager Yang's pants were pulled down in an instant...

"I'll tell you that's not true."
"But why are you taking my pants off?"
"You'll have to try it to know."
"Huh...?"
"Whether I have erectile dysfunction or not. Manager Yang, you'll have to experience it yourself and explain it to me."

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)
synonyms: Hidden BL Special Lecture: The Boss’s Unethical Leadership ~The Upright Manager~

title.native: 숨어 보는 BL 특강 : 상사의 비윤리적 리더십 ~곧추선 팀장님~
title.romaji: Sumeo Boneun BL Teukgang: Sangsaui Biyullijeong Rideosim - Gotchuseon Team-jangnim

199122.description:
A-Rang, the number one hero in both popularity and ability, encounters the villain leader, Ra-On, at a dispatched location after receiving a report.

"How does it feel? This must be your first time experiencing something like this."

Ra-On skillfully penetrates A-Rang's gap and stimulates his body with his tentacles. It's only a single contact, but the sensations don't subside. He barely manages to escape Ra-On's grasp, but why does he keep thinking about him more than his lover?

"Whoever it is, I don't care. I want to be raped like last time."

(Source: Anytoon, translated)

199123.description:
After 8 years in Seoul, San-Deul returns home and agrees to mentor a former student—only to find that Kang-Woo is no longer the innocent kid he remembers. Yet somewhere beneath the surface, Kang-Woo's soft spot for San-Deul never quite faded, and what begins as mentorship slowly becomes something more.

(Source: Manta)

199124.description:
When a freak accident in a storm leaves Jioh's childhood crush Woojin possessed by a ghost, Jioh can't walk away from the boy who once saved him. Joining forces with a mysterious spiritual medium, they fight to reclaim Woojin's soul—but the line between ghost and the boy he loves keeps blurring.

(Source: Manta)

199125.description:
To Ji-Han, the only son of the prestigious Choi family, Kim Seo-On has always been a thorn in his side. An adopted orphan, he acts as the eldest son, stealing his father's favor, and now trying to steal his future wife. Eventually, Ji-Han seeks out the shaman Yong-Han to ask him to kill Seo-On . The shaman offers a clever plan: to use a sex worker, as Seo-On is a man of excessive lust. One night, while the rest of the family is away, Seo-On, who has consumed an aphrodisiac, falls into a deep sleep. However, in a moment of carelessness, Seo-On opens his eyes...

In the frozen dawn of February, a game of hide-and-seek with a beast begins.

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

199126.description:
One night, a mysterious viewer named “Santa” drops over ten million won on Sunny (real name Sun Ikyung) in a single stream. The shock is real, the thrill is undeniable… and the donor’s identity is a total mystery. What Sunny doesn’t know? Santa is no stranger. As the extravagant donations continue, and Santa’s teasing, suggestive requests get bolder, Sunny realizes he doesn’t mind the attention at all. Caught between three potential suitors and one very rich secret admirer, Sunny sets out to uncover the truth: Who is the “Santa” showering him with money, and...is he boyfriend material?

(Source: Lezhin US)

199127.description:
Yun Wu-Seung is just a host trying to get by, but a strange encounter with his boss, Yeom Tae-Jeong, changes everything. Fascinated by Wuseung's eccentricities, the wealthy club owner dangles money to pull Wu-Seung into a toxic, twisted situationship. Tae-Jeong views him as nothing more than a temporary fix to be enjoyed on demand, but as they spend more time together, the cracks in their fractured pasts begin to show.

(Source: Lezhin US)

199128.description:
Kidnapped by an unfamiliar organization, Yeo-Woon is subjected to brutal torture under the pretext of interrogation. The one who rescues him is a murderous man, Gun-Hyeok, who appears to be part of the organization. Feeling responsible for Yeo-Woon's plight, Gun-Hyeok disobeys orders from his superiors to kill him. Traumatized, Yeo-Woon, physically and mentally exhausted, begins to open up to Gun-Hyeok's care...

"My dear, Yeo-Woon. You're dead. If you're scared and want to give up, leave it to me. I'll save you."

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

199130.description:
Once celebrated as a gifted shaman, Kwon Hae-Eon has fallen far from grace. Having lost his divine power, he survives by scamming clients and pretending his abilities still exist. Then one night, Mun U-Jin, a devout Christian man possessed by an unknown entity, bursts into the shrine and jumps him. The moment their bodies intertwine, Hae-Eon’s long dormant spiritual power suddenly returns. Sensing an opportunity, Hae-Eon manipulates the unlucky, possession plagued U-Jin into staying at the shrine. Each night, using U-Jin’s body as a medium, he engages with the mysterious being inside him, restoring more of his stolen energy. But when morning comes, U-Jin remembers nothing. All he sees are the unmistakable remnants of intense, forbidden intimacy that occurred while he was unaware. For a man who has lived his life with strict faith and purity, the truth feels like a divine punishment.

“How much worse can my luck get, Lord? Why must I endure this torment?”

(Source: Lezhin US)

199131.description:

2. Motto Kashite (もっと貸して, Lend Me It Some More); Weekly Kairakuten 2024 No.17

title.romaji: Izakaya de 1-jikan-han Mataseru Onna wa Saiaku

title.romaji: Susukino no Bunny Girl-ten de Uchiawase

199135.description:
The genius Kuroda Kanbee aims to become the best military strategist in Japan! Misfortune, betrayal, injustice... Kanbee overcomes the misfortunes of the Warring States period with his unyielding ambition! Introducing the Warring States period comedy of Kuroda Kanbee, the military strategist who supported Hideyoshi and was full of love and compassion!

(Source: Young Animal, translated)

title.native: 軍師　黒田官兵衛伝

199136.description: Note: Published in the 2025 #1 issue of Big Comic Superior.

title.native: きみの虫歯菌ならいいよ
title.romaji: Kimi no Mushibakin Nara Ii yo

199137.description:
The Demon King, who was defeated by a hero 20 years ago, has been reincarnated as an ordinary young man and is enjoying life in this world. However, his peaceful daily life is shattered by the visit of a small child wearing a pot on his head and carrying a sword. The sword is the same as the one worn by the hero who once killed the Demon King, and the Demon King realizes that the hero has been reincarnated in the present day as a child. Even though he was once killed, he cannot leave the young hero alone in the present day...

(Source: Natalie, translated)
synonyms: The Guardian Demon King and the Child Hero

title.native: 保護者な魔王と子ども勇者
title.romaji: Hogosha na Maou to Kodomo Yuusha

199138.description:
"I don't use cheap products, so this feels fresh!" Sayama, a plain and unattractive office lady, is beauty-tested by her colleague, Misono, a self-proclaimed cool-toned girl. One day, at her colleague's request, Sayama ends up attending a group date, something she's not very good at, but...

(Source: BookLive, translated)
synonyms: The Cage of Superiority and Inferiority

199139.description:
Farewell Tokyo, Viva Shizuoka. Rinko, a woman in her late twenties, can't get used to Tokyo and returns to her hometown of Shizuoka. She finds herself re-employed by a Tokyo man who enjoys life in Shizuoka, a carnivorous woman in her twenties who has her eye on him, and a boss who is devoted to his hometown. This new local four-panel comic will have Shizuoka residents, Tokyo-loving people, and everyone in Japan laughing.

(Source: Houbunsha, translated)

title.native: ローカル女子の遠吠え

199140.description: Note: Published in the 2023 #20 issue of Big Comic Superior.

title.native: 俺の尿路結石と高橋さん
title.romaji: Ore no Nyouro Kesseki to Takahashi-san

199141.description:
"Honest people cannot be deceived, so be more honest than anyone else." With these words from her late father, who was also a lawyer, in her heart, Higa Aki works hard as a rookie lawyer at a major law firm. The first case she is assigned to handle on her own is a lawsuit filed against the giant IT corporate group "Next Prism." Aki prepares meticulously for the trial, but the opposing lawyer is Yagi Wataru, a former con man with a criminal record. It seems that Yagi has known Aki for a long time... The legal entertainment that deceives people begins!!

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

title.native: よき法律家は悪しき隣人

199142.description: Note: Published in the August 2022 issue of Shounen Sunday S.

title.native: 高圧的になりきれない高原さん

199144.description: Note: Published in the 2024 #3 issue of Big Comic Superior.

title.native: ラブホに誘われやることは
title.romaji: Love Hotel ni Sasoware Yaru Koto wa

199145.description:
Graduate student Oku prefers a quiet, peaceful life, avoiding contact with others whenever possible. One day, while spending time alone in the fishing club room, he is interrupted by Hoshina, a cheerful, friendly undergrad who suddenly says he wants to join the club. Oku's peaceful days are quickly disrupted by Hoshina's bright, outgoing personality.

But when Oku steps in to help Hoshina as he is being hit on by another man, the two discover not only that they are both gay but also that they share another hidden secret: they conceal animal ears. Their outlooks on life couldn't be more different, yet...

(Source: LEED Publishing, translated)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

199146.description:
Manga adaptation of Jean-Henri Fabre's book series "Souvenirs entomologiques".

This work was released in Oubunsha Meisaku Manga Series B9 and B23.

199147.description: Story created for Osamu Tezuka's 90th birthday. Inspired by his 1979 work, "Lunn flies into the Wind"/"Run ha Kaze no Naka".

199148.description:
The miracle-working doctor George died during saving people in his previous life. The cat fairy he saved felt deeply grateful to him, and followed him for generations. Even after his nine tails were broken, the cat fairy still wanted to snuggle up to him. You know, I like nothing but you in the world.

(Source: WebComics)

199149.description:
A story about a bunch of people who make their apartment a happy shared place while living different lives.

(Source: WebComics)

title.romaji: Zhu Zai Wo Gebi Di Na Jiahuo

199151.description:
A story about finding family in friendship, even when life gets in the way.

Note: Won the Grand Prize in the Winter 2023 Afternoon Four Seasons Award.

199153.description:
The Kingdom of Vanroah has fallen. Lansen, the last prince, flees with the remaining survivors to a faraway land. Vowing to one day revive the kingdom, he becomes a swordmaster at a young age, only for a treacherous incident to strip everything away. Powerless to protect those he loves, he uses an ancient artifact to travel 10,000 years back in time to the Age of the Arcane. There, its rich knowledge and wisdom help him avert disaster in the present. But each time he turns back the clock, new secrets emerge, entangling the past and present in ways he never foresaw.

(Source: WEBTOON)

title.english: The Swordmaster Who Leapt Through Time

199155.description:
“Does this just mean nobody's attracted to me?”
“Ugly... that's the eternal cross I've been forced to bear.”

Love courageously blossoms among women burdened by virginity complexes.

(Source: Seirin Kogeisha, translated)

199156.description:
In Tohoku, as far as the eye can see are rice fields, mountains, sky, and clouds. Gen Tanuki, a high school freshman who just moved from the city, finds friends at the arcade/restaurant "Again," beautiful Tohoku dialect, and delicious arcade food!

(Source: Houbunsha, translated)

199157.description: Note: Originally self-published for COMITIA 124, but reprinted in Galette issue 18.

199158.description:
Nao Kirishima inherits a house in the countryside from his late uncle, where he finds welcome respite from city life. His solitude is soon interrupted by an uninvited guest who barges his way into Nao's house—and into his life. This rainy season brings with it more than just a leaky roof, as Nao discovers one more thing his uncle left behind.

Notes:
- Originally published as a one-shot in CRAFT Vol. 112, was then picked up for serialization.
- Includes two extra chapters.

199159.description:
I had a childhood friend who was like family to me. He and I were truly 'friends,' but when I heard the news of his first love, I was devastated. I actually liked him...! I have to end this unrequited love no matter what! But... why is it so hard to stop liking him? Is this what unrequited love is like?!

The first ordeal of youth, sour yet sweet like lemonade, first love.

(Source: Naver, translated)

199160.description:
Half a century has passed since gekiga was born, but preceding gekiga, this author's “komaga” revolutionized traditional manga expression, profoundly influencing numerous contemporary artists. This collector's edition compiles his groundbreaking short stories—the origin of gekiga—alongside contributions from renowned artists like Takao Saitou, Yoshihiro Tatsumi, Shigeru Mizuki, and Hayao Miyazaki. Published to commemorate the 50th anniversary of gekiga's birth.

(Source: Shogakukan, translated)

title.native: 隣室の男 松本正彦「駒画」作品集
title.romaji: Rinshitsu no Otoko: Matsumoto Masahiko "Komaga" Sakuhinshuu

199161.description:
Sonoka, an unassuming office worker, faces a series of disappointments on dating apps, leading her to doubt if anyone will ever choose her. Despite this, her best friend Mihina, who is both beautiful and popular with men, remains a steadfast source of encouragement. Just as Sonoka contemplates withdrawing from the dating scene altogether, she suddenly hears her name called out... To her surprise, it's none other than the young and charming company President, Sakaki! Could it be that the same remarkable man who caught Mihina's interest now seeks Sonoka's attention?!

(Source: MangaPlaza)

title.native: じゃない方、だけど愛され婚～契約婚の相手は一途すぎる社長
title.romaji: Janai Hou, Dakedo Aisare Kon: Keiyaku Kon no Aite wa Ichizu Sugiru Shachou

199165.description:
"Happy Sepia: Okuma Rasuko Sakuhinshuu" contains three works. It includes her first serialized work, "Happy Sepia," which depicts a girl named Kaede who travels back in time 10 years to live her high school life with her benefactor, her teacher Minami; her debut work, "Aruji no Inu Ma ni!", which is about dogs with the ability to transform into humans; and "Hoshikuzu Telepath Special Edition: Utakata Seastar," a new work that delves deeper into the relationship between Umi, the protagonist of Stardust Telepath, and her younger sister Honami.

(Source: Natalie, translated)
synonyms: Happy Sepia: The Works of Okuma Rasuko

title.native: ハッピーセピア　大熊らすこ作品集

199166.description: Manga adaptation of Jean Webster's 1912 novel "Daddy-Long-Legs".

1. Tokyo Genshikou (東京幻視行)
2. Yume no Tsuzuki (夢のつづき)
3. Sasuke to Jiro (サスケとジロー)
4. THE BACK OF BEYOND ARTICLE 1 Tantei Nikki (THE BACK OF BEYOND ARTICLE1 探偵日記)
5. THE BACK OF BEYOND ARTICLE 2 Ounisoroji (THE BACK OF BEYOND ARTICLE 2 オーニソロジ)
6. THE BACK OF BEYOND ARTICLE 3 Moguri sakaba (THE BACK OF BEYOND ARTICLE 3 もぐり酒場)
7. 1997-nen no Ansatsusha (1997年の暗殺者 (関川夏央・共作)

9. Hakushoku Chitai #2 Kabe no Ana (白色地帯 #2 壁の穴)
10. CHERGY (シェルギ)
11. Dash! (ダッシュ!)

title.native: 東京幻視行―単行本未収録傑作短編集

199173.description:
After a night of heavy drinking with his competent and dependable coworker Kamiya, Kaji slowly begins to regain his consciousness... Only to find Kamiya straddled right on top of him, legs spread and wearing nothing but a half-unbuttoned shirt. When Kaji is finally able to muster the energy to get up, he immediately asks Kamiya to explain himself. His response? "Things went sour with my hook-up buddy, and I've been pent up lately. That's all." Since that day, for some reason, Kaji begins feeling drawn to Kamiya. This is the story of a recently divorced man, his coworker who's secretly promiscuous, and the attraction that forms between them, set in the world of the ever-competitive Toto First Bank's head office.

(Source: MangaPlaza)

Note: Includes two extra chapters.

title.english: You Love Me, Huh? Don't Make Me Laugh.
title.native: 俺が好きなど嗤わせる

synonyms: 朱色の仮面 番外編

199175.description: Note: Includes the one-shot "Tsuzuki wa Yoake made Matte (続きは夜明けまで待って)" and one extra chapter.
synonyms: 続きは夜明けまで待って

title.native: あまやかコンプレックス

199176.description:
AC-197. Peace has returned to the people. And from this point on in history, weapons known as mobile suits, including the Gundams, were never seen again in the Earth Sphere. However, as long as mankind exists, there will always be battles. And that is precisely why an organization called the Preventers must exist. Heero and the others of PREVENTER-7 embark on a new operation to extinguish the flames that threaten to consume the perfect peace.

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)
synonyms: Shin Kidou Senki Gundam W 0.5 Point Half Preventer-7
Shin Kidou Senki Gundam Wing 0.5 Point Half Preventer-Set
MOBILE SUIT GUNDAM WING 0.5 POINT HALF PREVENTER-7

title.native: 新機動戦記ガンダムW 0.5POINT HALF PREVENTER-7
title.romaji: Shin Kidou Senki Gundam Wing: 0.5 POINT HALF PREVENTER-7

199177.description:
After a violent outburst in his first match, an amateur MMA fighter haunted by dreams of a past life as a gladiator is offered a chance to go pro, if he survives the fight. He’s untrained, unhinged, and utterly untamable.

(Source: Toomics)

199179.description:
We'll help you discover your hidden instincts! Meet the Instinct Development Team in the provocative and stimulating development project of Mr. Blue's rookies.

(Source: Mr.Blue, translated)

1-9. My Doll Diary (마이 돌 다이어리) [Yu-On]
10-19. Eojeui Hwangtaejaneun Oneurui Sukeotsinbu (어제의 황태자는 오늘의 수컷신부) [Myeonmyeon x Jak]
20-28. Deformation (데포르마숑) [Illil x 29]
29-36. Choegoui Gomun (최고의 고문) [AMAEN]

synonyms: How dare you name it destiny!?

title.native: どの口で運命とか言ってんだ
title.romaji: Dono Kuchi de Unmei toka Itten da

title.native: ザット·ガール·デイ·イン·ザ·ライフ
title.romaji: That Girl Day in the Life

199183.description:
Asuka Miyamoto was working as an insurance salesperson in Tokyo when her grandfather Shigeru warned her that something was amiss at their family shrine. Her brother Souichi, who had taken over the shrine, has gone missing and a shady real-estate agent is now attempting to seize it. Assisted by Juuzou, her grandfather’s student, she starts looking for countermeasures and learns about a strange festival called the "Killing of the Phoenix". Agreeing to take over as chief priest, Sakuya will do her best to revitalize her declining hometown and shrine by resurrecting the "Killing of the Phoenix"!

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

title.native: ガールズインアポカリプス

synonyms: The Funeral Flame Blade & The Immortal Witch

title.native: ハウリング・ブレイズ 葬焔の剣士と不死の魔女
title.romaji: Howling Blaze: Souen no Kenshi to Fushi no Majo

199188.description: A collection of Tiger Tateishi's early works.

title.native: コンニャロ+デジタル商会―タイガー立石作品集

199189.description:
Elis Lars, the daughter of a marquis, is an ordinary girl. Her grades are average, her personality is mild, and her marquis family's status is not particularly high. If there's anything particularly noteworthy about her, it's that her servants are exceptionally skilled and loyal. The crown prince, who wanted to make them his aides, gets a glimpse of Elis's extraordinary qualities when he's in a pinch. The twins, the Deputy Director of the Ministry of Magic, and even the "Mad Dog Butler" all swear loyalty to her, but what is the true identity of Elis?! A peerless love story between a (not so) ordinary young lady and a perverted butler in another world!

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

title.native: 平凡な令嬢 エリス・ラースの日常
title.romaji: Heibon na Reijou Elis Lars no Nichijou

199190.description: Note: Contains the one-shots Fujin Kouron (夫人公論), and Mitsubachi no Miko (蜜蜂の巫女)

199191.description:
High school girl Shirokawa Komomo has an ambition: to make "male friends"! But then she notices that her classmate Oba-kun, who always smiles when talking with other boys, is completely expressionless when talking with girls... Is making male friends actually much harder than finding a boyfriend? A youthful friendship comedy brought to you by a new generation!

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

199192.description:
Just before her passing, Seul-Gi's grandmother hands her a mysterious note. On it is an address where her grandmother claims to have hidden a secret inheritance. But when Seul-Gi visits the location, she finds that a stranger is already living there!

Will Seul-Gi be able to become the heiress she was meant to be?

(Source: Manta)

199194.description:
Forced onto a team with her academy rival, Regan Clanford, Leona Everhart is stunned when the gods declare their future child the world’s savior. She’d rather slay the Demon King than marry Regan — but with meddling deities, resisting fate won’t be easy.

(Source: Manta)

title.native: 世界の運命を賭けた結婚
title.romaji: Sekai no Unmei wo Kaketa Kekkon

199195.description: Early "komaga" kashihon published by Hinomaru Bunko.

199196.description:
After clashing with her stepbrother Filio over the throne, Lea is executed by Filio's hand - and when she wakes up, she finds herself reverted to being 15 years old! In order to avoid any conflict this time, Lea intends to win over her stepbrother and make him her ally, but instead she finds herself becoming obsessed with Filio, wanting to have her stepbrother all to herself.

He's supposed to be her cute stepbrother, but it seems there's more to him than just his sister complex that Lea doesn't know about...

(Source: KADOKAWA, translated)

title.native: 私を殺す義弟を籠絡しようと思います
title.romaji: Watashi wo Korosu Gitei wo Rourakushiyou to Omoimasu

199197.description:
Jeanne grew up in the church and aspires to become an exorcist. She has the ability to detect demonic possession, but is unable to control the special power that resides in reincarnated people. She is also troubled by her vague memories of her past life - in particular, her inability to remember the face of her brother.

(Source: KADOKAWA, translated)

title.native: お兄ちゃんが救ってあげる

199198.description:
I got my favorite character (a handsome knight) in exchange for breaking off my engagement...?

Sonia is a witch who has been reincarnated as the Last Boss of an anime. She knows that she will be defeated as an evil witch in the future.

Wanting to leave the story, Sonia accepts to break off her engagement to the prince, which leads to her downfall. In return, she succeeds in acquiring her favorite knight, Ville, as her squire.

Sonia hopes to live peacefully in her hometown with Ville, who had originally been her double, however, Ville hates witches and is always rebelling against her...? The "Last Boss Witch," defying her strange destiny, begins her heroic march!

title.native: らすぼす魔女は堅物従者と戯れる
title.romaji: Last Boss Majo wa Katabutsu Juusha to Tawamureru

199200.description:
Ha-Eun writes romance stories but has never created anything too explicit. When she finally does, her publisher ruthlessly rejects it for being too unrealistic! While venting to her childhood friend Si-Woo, Ha-Eun wonders if she should date around for inspiration, causing him to cry and confess to her. They end up at a motel, where Ha-Eun suggests being friends with benefits when Si-Woo clearly wants more. Can he win her over, or will Ha-Eun's need for sexy source material alienate her closest friend?

(Source: Tapas)

Note: Includes two extra chapters.

199201.description:
As the only daughter of a duke, far removed from harsh environments and survival, I never expected that humans would pose a greater threat than wild beasts. While frantically fleeing from those threatening me on an island where a cruise ship had wrecked, I encountered Igor, the knight I had personally taken in as a child, whom I had presumed dead. Under his protection, I quickly found peace, as if I had been saved. Before I knew it, a subtle emotion blossomed, a comfort I had never felt with my fiancé...

"Don't be too surprised."

Could I be saved once more by him, who had silently stayed by my side for years, claiming to desire my heart and body?

(Source: Lezhin, translated)
synonyms: How to Survive on an Island

199202.description:
Jae-Ha, who was dragged to a cross-dressing maid cafe by a friend's recommendation(?), falls in love at first sight with the maid in charge, Juno. While he is confused by the fact that he has fallen for a cross-dresser, he accidentally finds out that the student model Hyun-Woo, who contacted him for a departmental internship, is Juno...!

"Oh, but instead of telling anyone... show me yourself in a maid outfit one more time."

How can he fix his wrong first button to succeed in his first love?

(Source: Mr.Blue, translated)

title.romaji: Yeojangeneun Maid Man Inneun Ge Aniragoyo
Bokura wa Onaji Sora no Shita
Kokoro ni wa Nao Akai Ato
