何でも知りたいお年頃
The Age Where They Want to Know Everything

199210.description:
Ibuki, who suffers from infertility, is cheated on by her husband, who says, "I want my own child." After the divorce is decided, she is in a dire state. Ibuki is guided by the words of a male bartender who tells her, "This is the time to change your life and live a life that is more true to yourself." She decides to enroll in graduate school to pursue her dreams. But on campus, she meets the same male bartender again!?

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

title.native: 二度目の春に恋いぶき
title.romaji: Nidome no Haru ni Koi Ibuki

199211.description:
English language learning materials, hair removal, health foods... The Netai Ward Consumer Affairs Center in Tokyo continues to see a steady stream of people seeking advice on consumer-related issues.

A half-naked man born in the jungle and raised by orangutans suddenly appears at this modern-day refuge and declares, "I'm going to become the king of consumer affairs!"

(Source: Kodansha, translated)
synonyms: Mr. Tar: The King of Consumption

199212.description:
On an island overrun with monsters a boy named Shanan, who is cursed with immortality journies with the demonic cat, Tsuki.

(Source: Natalie, translated and edited)

title.native: 怪島奇譚～不死の少年と妖猫の旅～
title.romaji: Keshima Kitan: Fushi no Shounen to Youbyou no Tabi

199213.description:
Shiori has never been able to fit in with other people and can only enjoy interacting with animals. As Shiori struggles with her job search, a mysterious apartment appears before her...

The story follows the protagonist as the caretaker of the otherworldly apartment where "DEMI" lives.

(Source: Natalie, translated)

199214.description:
A mysterious boy arrives at the all-female Hinata household along with a meteor shower! One of the sisters is thrilled that her "big brother" has arrived, but what about Anju, who can't bring herself to be happy...?! A heartwarming story of family bonds!

(Source: Shogakukan, translated)

199215.description:
Akane Hayasaka loves a survival audition program where talented youngsters compete fiercely to become idols. One day, Akane learns that Fukami, who sits next to her at school, has passed the written examination for an extremely difficult audition. Akane hopes that the world will discover Fukami's brilliance, but Fukami himself doesn't seem keen on becoming an idol...

(Source: Natalie, translated)

title.native: となりの席の深美くんがアイドルになるかもしれない
title.romaji: Tonari no Seki no Futami-kun ga Idol ni Naru Kamo Shirenai

199216.description:
His only redeeming quality his looks, Akito, who works as a model, starts living with his younger cousin Junpei. Akito hasn't seen Junpei for seven years, and when they reunite, he finds that Junpei is exactly the type of guy he goes for. Junpei has been in love with Akito since he was in elementary school, and when he tells Akito how he feels, Akito tries to rush into the two of them sleeping together. But Junpei, who is the serious type, turns him down. Is Junpei's pure way of thinking about love too much of a hurdle for Akito?

(Source: Renta!)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.
synonyms: I don't mind if you are not so PURE.

title.english: I Don't Mind If You're Not So Pure
title.native: そんなにキレイじゃなくていい
title.romaji: Sonna ni Kirei ja Nakute Ii

199218.description:
Kaede, an office worker, was on a solo camping trip in the mountains to heal the pain of a broken heart when she suddenly found herself transported to another world. At first, she was scared of the monsters she had never seen before, but gradually she became stronger. Furthermore, Fenrir and the fairies joined her. Kaede's life as a camper in another world, with her steely mentality, begins now!

(Source: Futabasha, translated)

title.native: 一人キャンプしたら異世界に転移した話
title.romaji: Hitori Camp Shitara Isekai ni Teni Shita Hanashi

199219.description: The year is the 24th century. Humanity’s residences extend not only across Earth but throughout the entire universe. Amidst this, the protagonist, Hoshino, sets out to open a one-person “private real estate agency” with zero employees. In a market monopolized by large corporations with vast financial power, she aims to run a real estate business, striving to help customers find a home that is “the most perfect fit in the universe.”

199220.description:
Seiichirou and Miya are a married couple who fell in love at first sight and got married on day 0. With almost no romantic experience, the couple has not yet been able to hug, kiss, or even have sex, even though it will soon be a year since they were married. They try to somehow progress their relationship before their wedding anniversary in three months, but...

The story depicts their difficult newlywed life, full of "firsts."

(Source: Natalie, translated)

199222.description:
Feared as the Divine Demon, Cheon Jeong lived and died on the battlefield, knowing nothing but violence. When death finally claims him, it should have been the end. Instead, he awakens thirty years later in the body of Mujin Hwa, the powerless heir of a ruined clan. His overwhelming strength is gone, replaced by a frail body and enemies closing in from every side. To protect the siblings now in his care and reclaim a clan on the brink of collapse, the fallen legend must begin again and build a future from nothing.

(Source: WEBTOON)

199224.description:
Lucy has mysterious eyes like a starry night sky. To repay the kindness of the orphanage that raised her, she works as a maid for a baron's household, despite the harsh treatment she receives. One day, however, she is abducted by a mysterious handsome man. He seems to be searching for Lucy, a resident of Sky Island, a floating island 3,000 meters above ground, and the reincarnation of the "Stardust Goddess" who has the power to keep the island afloat. Sky Island is in danger of crashing in the near future, and to save it, Lucy must find fate and marry one of the four princes who live on Sky Island. Lucy is forced to submit to the threat that if the island crashes, her hometown will also be in danger... "I've never even been in love, so I can't possibly get married!" The ultimate romantic fantasy begins, weaving the fate of a girl who has never known love and a quirky prince!

(Source: Futabasha, translated)

title.native: 星屑の花嫁は運命の恋から逃げ出したい～王子様と強制結婚なんて無理！～
title.romaji: Hoshikuzu no Hanayome wa Unmei no Koi kara Nigedashitai: Ouji-sama to Kyousei Kekkon Nante Muri!

199225.description:
Charlotte, the daughter of a marquis, possesses a special ability: her emotions are reflected in the weather. Because of this, she always suppressed her feelings and lived with restraint. She never allowed herself to cry, to be angry, or even to feel joy. However, her fiancé Theodore suddenly breaks off their engagement. To make matters worse, he seems to be completely smitten with a sweet commoner girl named Verona. Having reached the limits of her patience, Charlotte decides to marry the king of the Kingdom of Shurton—a land of barren soil. Her new fiancé, Azul, begins showering her with overwhelming affection that knows no bounds—!?

(Source: Futabasha, translated)
synonyms: 감정이 날씨에 반영되는 특수능력을 가진 영애는 약혼을 파기 당해 불모의 대지로 시집가고 싶다

title.native: 感情が天候に反映される特殊能力持ち令嬢は婚約解消されたので不毛の大地へ嫁ぎたい
title.romaji: Kanjou ga Tenkou ni Hanei sareru Tokushu Nouryoku-mochi Reijou wa Konyaku Kaishou sareta node Fumou no Daichi e Totsugitai

199226.description:
Kotori is the girl who's always alone and Kohaku is Mr. Popular. That's the social hierarchy in their class. Kohaku takes every opportunity he gets to have a go at Kotori: "You're in the way!" "Alone again?""I don't like your attitude." Kotori doesn't particularly like Kohaku, either. But one day, she receives sage advice from Panda, her online friend. Even though Kohaku always puts on a tough front, Kotori begins to feel like the two of them might not be so different after all. And then, Kohaku begins to treat her with an aloof sort of kindness. Could it be that Kotori is kind of becoming interested in him...? Kohaku, normally mean and distant, shows his sweet, soft side - it's sure to give you butterflies!!

(Source: Manga Plaza)

title.english: Your Voice Is Sour... Yet Sweet
title.native: キミの声はイジワルで…甘い
title.romaji: Kimi no Koe wa Ijiwaru de... Amai

199227.description:
"Sakura, can I touch you?" Even though I decided never to fall in love again... I'm trying to drown in this love. Sakura, an office worker who tries to maintain her daily routine, is chosen to train a university student, Tsubaki. However, due to a "certain reason", she overreacts every time Tsubaki gets close to her. On top of that, Tsubaki suggested practicing with him! Though intended purely as practice, every time he touches her and says her name, she feels sparks from within. Sakura became serious too... This is a love story about a clumsy woman and a college student who has learned what pure love is.

(Source: Manga Plaza)

title.english: I Want to Drown in Tsubaki's Heat
title.native: 椿くんの熱におぼれたい

199229.description:
An outlaw of the light blade saves the galaxy! A space opera of blazing stars and tangled fates!!

In a galaxy swirling with chaos, two outlaws hunt bounties: Vorga, the beastman hailed as a “legend,” and his apprentice Jin, a novice bounty hunter. Determined to save his gravely ill sister, Jin ignores his master’s warnings and takes on a job worth 300 million Dallas. The mission: rescue Princess Lise Songmarl of planet Quantol, who has been abducted. But Jin soon finds himself face-to-face with the worst enemy of all—his parents’ murderer. The princess is fleeing with the supernova weapon Vermilion, and the “Immortal Hand” of the destroyer Nomad blocks Jin’s path...

For the sake of the princess—and the future—this half-fledged outlaw must rise to save the universe!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

199230.description:
Seong Ga-Yeon, a contestant on a girl idol competition show, bonds with the irascible and ill-tempered top star, So-Woo, throughout the competition, building a captivating chemistry and ultimately advancing to the final stage. However, she is eliminated from the debut group. Before she can even begin to console herself, So-Woo's spiritual eyes are opened, revealing that she not only sees ghosts but is also destined to die soon. And the cause is none other than herself! Seong Ga-Yeon learns that saving So-Woo from ghosts a thousand times will ensure a peaceful afterlife for Ga-Yeon, so she disguises herself as a man, changes her name, and gets a job as So-woo's bodyguard...! Seong Woo-Yeon learned both bodyguarding and exorcism on YouTube. Starting today, she debuts as an exorcist!

(Source: Kakaopage, translated)
synonyms: I Debuted as an Exorcist Instead of an Idol

199232.description:
The world's greatest master becomes the instructor of students with countless stories?!

Seok Won-Cho, the leader of the Demonic Cult, was a monster that surpassed even the Blood Cult. Do you know who killed him?

“Ha Mu-Baek.”
“But why that story...”
“They say he’s coming to our Mengryongdae as an instructor.”

… Damn it. It’s over! Ha Mu-Baek, the world’s greatest martial artist who destroyed the Demonic Cult and the Blood Cult. He gets caught up in a power struggle and is appointed as an instructor at a martial arts training institute. He thought he should hide his identity and live quietly, but he’s strangely busy… ? Welcome, is this your first time as a genius idiot instructor?!

(Source: Kakaopage, translated)
synonyms: The World's Greatest Martial Arts Instructor
The Best Martial Arts Instructor In The World

199233.description:
After losing her parents, Aina lives with her uncle, who inherited the Dukedom of Ashbel, but is oppressed by her stepmother and stepsister every day... Suddenly, her stepmother announces to Aina that she is engaged to be married to Earl Euston. It is not the marriage proposal she hoped for, but for Aina, it is a chance to be freed from her oppressive life. Her dream of gaining freedom is short-lived, as she learns that she has simply been sold to a pervert in exchange for a large sum of money, and she is overcome with despair. With no way to escape from her carriage, Prince Shion appears to save her! Although the prince tells Aina that he has been "looking for her all this time," Aina has no memory of even meeting him. Why on earth was she saved? What do Shion's words mean? And will the reunion of these two be a blessing, or the beginning of misfortune?

(Source: Cmoa Comics, translated)

title.native: 唇に毒薬～死なずの王子は彼女の愛で眠りにつきたい～
title.romaji: Kuchibiru ni Dokuyaku: Shinazu no Ouji wa Kanojo no Ai de Nemuri ni Tsukitai

199234.description:
"Today, I will be offered as a sacrifice to God."

While gods may look no different from humans, they rule society with overwhelming power... Every few years, humans offer a bride to the most powerful of the gods, the Chief God. However, not a single bride has returned... To speak out against the unreasonable and unfair situation, town girl Noru decides to be offered as a bride in place of her best friend. What fate awaits Noru as she risks her life to fight back?

(Source: Cmoa Comics, translated)

199235.description:
Clear is a young girl who lives with the prestigious Crow family, which takes in and raises orphans. Though she is a diligent and kind-hearted girl who is entrusted with caring for the young children, she is constantly treated coldly by her stepmother and stepsisters. One day, Clear is forced into high society by her stepsister Adelna's machinations, but her efforts are robbed and she is made a fool of in high society. As she is crying alone, she is approached by Farok, the heir to the Hawk family, who rule the land. His unexpected words will greatly change Clear's fate.

(Source: Cmoa Comics, translated)

title.native: 価値ナシ令嬢は人嫌い大尉に守護される
title.romaji: Kachi Nashi Reijou wa Hitogirai Taii ni Shugo Sareru

199236.description:
Tokita Ima, 42 years old. She has been married to her husband for 15 years. They became a couple because they loved each other, but now they barely talk to each other. "Our relationship as a couple has cooled, but we're doing well as a family," she thought, but then her husband was involved in an accident and lost his memory...

(Source: Bungeishunju, translated)

title.native: 夫婦が両思いになる方法
title.romaji: Fuufu ga Ryou Omoi ni Naru Houhou

199237.description:
Aa school romance fantasy starring Usagi, a high school girl who lost her mother at a young age and struggles to be accepted by her new family. The story begins one day when Usagi stays behind at school to help prepare for the school festival, and happens upon three prominent classmates - Yuuko Masamune, Sekirou Yakki, and Kumayoshi Shino - fighting someone.

(Source: Natalie, translated)

title.native: 兎は獣の肚の底でしあわせな夢をみる
title.romaji: Usagi wa Kemono no Hara no Soko de Shiawase na Yume wo Miru

199238.description:
29-year-old Rio Ichijo is a company CEO at the forefront of the bridal industry. Her father, who aimed for an arranged marriage, raised her to be the perfect lady, but she has grown into a strong woman who prioritizes work over romance and strives to seize happiness for herself. She met Masaomi, a congressman, at an arranged marriage meeting, but the engagement was called off when he requested something. Then, a new person appears and causes unexpected ripples in Rio's life.

(Source: Natalie, translated)

title.native: 世話焼き母さん娘の彼氏に頼まれて一肌脱ぐ
title.romaji: Sewayaki Kaa-san Musume no Kareshi ni Tanomarete Hitohada Nugu

title.native: イジメっ子に母を寝取られた話誰か聞きたい？
title.romaji: Ijimekko ni Haha wo Netorareta Hanashi Dare ka Kikitai?

title.native: お母さん達と王様ゲームしてエッチな命令する話
title.romaji: Okaa-san-tachi to Ou-sama Game shite Ecchi na Meirei suru Hanashi

title.native: 母の再婚相手の連れ子がイヤらしい
title.romaji: Haha no Saikon Aite no Tsureko ga Iyarashii

title.native: 思春期息子はお母さんに欲情する
title.romaji: Shishunki Musuko wa Okaa-san ni Yokujou suru

199245.description: A series about Dr. Hoop's adventures originally published in Garo.

title.native: フープ博士の月への旅
title.romaji: Hoop Hakase no Tsuki e no Tabi

title.native: ヒキニートが妹の友達に一方的にせめられる
title.romaji: Hiki NEET ga Imouto no Tomodachi ni Ippouteki ni Semerareru

title.native: レスの母親がヤリチンの息子にせまられる
title.romaji: Less no Hahaoya ga Yarichin no Musuko ni Semarareru

199249.description: A one-shot published in Fusion Product 1982 vol. 7.

199250.description:
Jae-In witnesses her crush, Hyun-Ho, receive a confession and decides then and there to bury her feelings. The two remain close friends beyond high school. After a secret piercing Jae-In got as a small act of rebellion against her parents becomes infected, she has only one person to turn to for help: Hyun-Ho. His idea of treatment lands them in some compromising situations, forcing Jae-In to decide whether she’s willing to risk the happiness she’s found at his side—or take a chance on something more.

(Source: Tapas)

Note: Includes six extra chapters.
synonyms: เจาะรักให้ตรงใจ

199251.description:
A luxury store. A new customer arrives at a run-down rural supermarket: Na Kang-Ju. With his muscular physique and tall stature, he instantly steals Hye-Won's attention... Despite his perfect appearance, he possesses a somewhat shady personality. Hye-Won discovers the man's secret: he's cursed to turn into a bear when he drinks alcohol! Hye-Won decides to help him, willing to sacrifice herself, to break the curse.

"You said you'd help me, to lift the curse. So, hold on a little longer."

Despite his harsh voice, his back is brimming with patience.

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

199252.description:
In and Yuu, who become brothers due to certain circumstances, encounter a bizarre incident. In finds Yuu, who has become unable to speak due to a past incident and has a weak reaction, annoying. One day, he receives news that Yuu has been trapped in an elevator at the place where he works part-time... The story depicts the mysterious spirits surrounding the two.

(Source: Natalie, translated)
synonyms: 因と聿（ユウ）の事件簿 水漬（しみ）

title.native: 因と聿の事件簿 水漬
title.romaji: In to Yuu no Jikenbo Mizu Shimi

title.native: ドスケベレッスン〜ムッチリ幼馴染で男磨き〜
title.romaji: Dosuke Lesson: Mucchiri Osananajimi de Otoko Migaki

199255.description:
Huuuuuuuuuuuuuuuff! ♥

(Source: Fakku!)

Note: Published in Comic Kairakuten 2025-08

title.native: 柊先輩くんくんくんくん

199256.description:
Natalie, who used to be a daughter of a count, was forced to marry a nobleman in another country. She was treated cruelly by her mother-in-law and her servants. Even her husband challenged her to die on her own if she can. She did--thinking there were nothing good in the last ten years of her life.

When she opened her eyes, she was alive, back in her happy life which was ten years ago. If she tries, maybe she can change her fate...avoid the tragedy that awaits her. Natalie knows that soon she will lose her parents by a disease and a war, and she has to marry the Dark Knight, who saves this country... She won't let that happen again.

(Source: KADOKAWA)

title.native: 「死んでみろ」と言われたので死にました。

199257.description:
1. Mou Ichido, Kimi no Egao ga Mitai (もう一度、君の笑顔が見たい); Comic LO 2024-02
2. Just Size (ジャストサイズ); Comic LO 2024-12
3. Fukurokouji no Mukougawa (袋小路の向こう側); Comic LO 2025-10
synonyms: Mou Ichido, Kimi no Egao ga Mitai
もう一度、君の笑顔が見たい

title.native: 少女はダマされ犯されて

199258.description:
1. Sensei ni Tsukeru Kusuri Wanai! (先生につけるクスリはない!, No Potion Works on Sensei!); Comic Kairakuten 2023-05
2. Hatarake! Minami-chan! (はたらけ! みなみちゃん!, Work It! Minami-chan!); Comic Kairakuten 2023-10
3. Mootto Hatarake! Minami-chan! (もぉ～っと! はたらけ! みなみちゃん!)
4. Rojiura no Uranaishi-san (路地裏の占い師さん, Back-Alley Fortune Teller); Comic Kairakuten 2024-07
5. Kyoushi to Seito ga Owaru Toki (教師と生徒が終わるとき, When You Stop Being Teacher and Student); Comic Kairakuten 2025-01
6. Bunny Cos Honey (ばにこす☆はにー, Cosplay Honey ☆ Bunny); Comic Kairakuten 2022-12
7. Honya-san no Himegoto (本屋さんの秘めゴト, The Bookstore's Secret); Comic Kairakuten 2021-12
8. Open☆Summer Dai Sakusen (オープン☆サマー大作戦, Open ☆ Summer Grand Strategy); Comic Kairakuten 2024-03

199259.description:
War hero and army captain Fedele Aske is haunted by the ghosts of his past, preventing him from getting any sleep at night without a woman to warm his bed. When one of his nightly companions turns out to be an enemy spy, Princess Igraine forbids him from taking any more women into his tent as his military adviser. But the lack of sleep greatly impairs Fedele’s abilities on the battlefield, leaving Igraine with no choice. She’ll just have to be the one to ease his restless nights from now on...

(Source: Tappytoon)

199260.description:
[Only the Demon King and the Hero are Inhabitants! A Super High-Tension ☆ Otherworldly Gag!!]

Heaven's Grace, a closed world created by a mischievous god, is inhabited by superhumans who have been forcibly summoned from numerous dimensions.
Namihira Hajime, an all-too-ordinary first-year high school student, has been summoned to a prison where only the Demon King and the Hero are Inhabitants!!

The beautiful Demon King Metanoia! The beautiful Hero Sakura! Led by them, Demon Kings and Heroes attack one after another!!

Namihira Hajime, the representative of humanity, begins his life-risking otherworldly life!! A hilarious ☆ Otherworldly Gag Comic is here to be born!!!

title.native: 魔王と勇者しかいない世界
title.romaji: Maou to Yuusha Shika Inai Isekai

199261.description:
"I might have to live without a handsome husband, but I refuse to throw away my first time like this!"

Cielo is about to be sent into the palace as a concubine for an aging king. She’s determined not to let her precious first experience be wasted on someone she doesn't desire. Her target? Her steadfast and loyal guard, Caelum. She throws every seductive trick in the book at him, pressing her body against his in a bold attempt to break him. Yet, the stoic knight remains infuriatingly composed, ignoring her wicked temptations. But is he truly as indifferent as he seems, or is there a hidden fire burning beneath that cold armor?

(Source: Manta)

Note: Part of Metaoon's Noecheongsun Danpyeonseon (뇌청순 단편선) Collection.
synonyms: [뇌청순 단편선] 첫 경험은 잘생긴 기사랑 할래요
[Noecheongsun Danpyeonseon] Cheon Gyeongheomeun Jalsaenggin Gisarang Hallaeyo
[Pure Anthology] I Want My First Time With a Handsome Knight

title.english: Saving My First Time Handsome Knight

title.native: ミントさんはあまあま交尾したい。～巨乳ヒーラーのお姉さんがめちゃくちゃ誘ってくる話～
title.romaji: Mint-san wa Amaama Koubi shitai.: Kyonyuu Healer no Onee-san ga Mechakucha Sasotte kuru Hanashi

199263.description:
Da-Gyeong and Seong-Jae were inseparable as kids. But as they grew up, Seong-Jae became a delinquent and a notorious playboy, or so Da-Gyeong thought. But when the topic of an arranged marriage comes up between the two, Seong-Jae admits he's still a virgin and has been saving himself for his childhood sweetheart. Is he telling the truth, or is this just another scheme in his womanizing playbook?

(Source: Tapas)

Note: Part of Metatoon's Dongjeongnam Danpyeonseon (동정남 단편선) Collection.

title.english: How to Savor Your Childhood Friend

199264.description:
"If not me, who will teach you love?"

Dr. Jonathan, an eccentric genius with no interest in anything but research. Yet, he has come up with a groundbreaking invention that will change the landscape of human mating: the "love potion," aka the "pheromone cocktail." Excited by the prospect of becoming rich, Jonathan orders his research assistant, Sabrina, to hold a press conference. Sabrina asks Jonathan to include her name as a collaborator, but Jonathan flatly refuses. Furious, Sabrina lunges at Jonathan, and after a fierce struggle, the pheromone cocktail douses them both. Drunk on the pheromone cocktail, Sabrina seduces Jonathan, handcuffs him, and ties him up so he can't attend the press conference. With four hours left until the press conference... Will Jonathan be able to satisfy Sabrina?

(Source: Lezhin, translated)

199265.description:
Koutarou's dying to sleep with his boyfriend Youhei, but the latter insists they hold off until exam season is over. Still, Koutarou just can't control his urges and lets his imagination go wild...
The two eventually make it into bed together, but things don't go quite as planned. It turns out they'll need practice and even more patience before they can experience the pleasure of going all the way!

A sweet story of two young men's journey through love and intimacy!

(Source: Renta!)

Notes:
- Chapter 5 was split into two parts in the original serialization and later combined in the volume release.
- Includes one extra chapter.

title.native: 佐伯くんはアレがしたい

199266.description:
Eunju is a timid, slightly gloomy twenty-year-old with a secret she can never tell anyone. Whenever she holds hands with a man, her body reacts far more intensely than it should. Her quiet life takes a sharp turn when her sunbae Hyeyeong, a self-proclaimed expert in “adult matters,” discovers Eunju’s secret. From that moment on, Hyeyoung decides to take Eunju under her wing, and the two embark into a wild world neither of them came prepared for.

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note: Includes three extra chapters.

199267.description:
Koutarou Izumi, a love story novelist, has a secret weapon for when he runs out of ideas: the bittersweet diary of his one-sided love for Takaaki Yamamoto, a classmate back in college. When a friend mentions to Koutarou that Takaaki's gotten married, he decides to try out a dating app in order to find a new love, to find new tropes for his novels... and to forget about Takaaki...
On his first date using the app, Koutarou's nervous walking to the meeting point, and who does he see there, waiting for him...!? This must be fate...

(Source: Renta!)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

title.english: A Lying Novelist And His Fated One
title.native: 嘘つき小説家と運命の人
title.romaji: Usotsuki Shousetsuka to Unmei no Hito

199268.description:
As a former soccer player, I'm back in time 10 years.

"Now I know who will become soccer stars. I'll find the hidden gems and build the best team."

A sports story about the breathtaking recruiting front office, more so than the actual game itself.

(Source: Naver, translated)

199269.description:
Tomo's in love with his neighbor, Takeru, but Takeru's totally obsessed with his two brothers. What bothers Tomo the most, though, is the fact that Takeru doesn't seem to notice how he feels about him, no matter how hard he tries. Is it because he's younger? Or is it because he's a childhood friend? These questions plague his mind. And, because of that, Takeru walks around naked in front of Tomo and kisses him as if he were family! Tomo finally tells Takeru that he wants to date him directly, but...

A love story between a young guy and his beautiful, dense neighbor!

(Source: Renta!)

Note: Includes three extra chapters.
synonyms: The Brother Complex Eldest Son and Process to be in Love

title.english: How I Fell In Love With My Brother-Obsessed Neighbor
title.native: ブラコン長男と恋するプロセス

199270.description:
Haruki, an office worker who loves boys' love comic books, is fascinated with incubi. One day, he jokingly recites a summoning spell... and makes a beautiful incubus appear before his eyes...!? A well-proportioned-face, an attractive body, a firm bottom... he is so perfect that it's beyond exciting! Unable to return to the demon world, Allen wants to steal Haruki's vitality, but he has never done it with a man...!! The way he moans in pleasure and sinks deeper and deeper in ecstasy is just too cute... "Incubi are really so naughty." The story of a sweet but sadistic office worker together with a sassy virgin incubus starts now!

(Source: Mobile Media Research)

title.english: Me, a Boys' Love Fanboy, Visited by an Incubus!?
title.native: 腐男子の俺のもとにツンデレ淫魔がくるなんて!?
title.romaji: Fudanshi no Ore no Moto ni Tsundere Inma ga Kuru Nante!?

199271.description:
Hiromu and Kouki's paths first crossed in college. Initial indifference soon morphed into a casual friends-with-benefits arrangement. For Kouki, Hiromu was never his 'type,' and Hiromu himself harbored feelings for someone else. Yet, as their physical relationship continued, a deeper connection began to form. Through shared vulnerability and unexpected intimacy, their hearts started to race, and unspoken feelings began to overflow.

(Source: CLLENN)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.
synonyms: I won't give it to you, Slight fever.

title.english: I Won't Give You Even the Slightest Fever

title.native: オランジェットは夜にとける

199274.description: IT professionals of the world... aim for... Kodansha...!! Kaiji, a self-indulgent unemployed man who spends all his time gambling, has finally got a job!? *This is a promotional manga for Kodansha's recruitment of experienced professionals.

title.native: アロマンティック×セクシャルラヴァー

199276.description:
"Black as the devil, hot as hell, pure as an angel..." Is that love or coffee?

Kusama Kou isn't sure, especially after he rediscovers that his first childhood crush is now a widowed coffee shop owner by the name of Sakurada.
Sakurada-san's kind, soothing, with an amazing voice, and much older than Kou - i.e. exactly Kou's type. So he wastes no time in getting himself hired part-time at Sakurada Coffee Shop, but is there really any hope for his love to be returned...?

Note: Includes one extra chapter.
synonyms: The collected reprint of Sakurada coffee shop

199277.description:
Abandoned by his family, Gunak is sold to the Hyungsan Sect for 20 gold coins. The Hyungsan Sect treats him as their own with affection and Gunak grows attached to them quickly. However, he leaves the sect for ten years, and when he returns...

(Source: Toomics)

title.english: The Tale of The Hyungsan Sect

199278.description:
When their classmate's expensive watch goes missing during swimming class, the prime suspects are the three students who sat out that day: Taewoong, Mitsuki, and Sakuma. Together, they set out on the hunt for the lost watch, but what they find is...

(Source: MANGA Plus)

title.native: プールサイド・メモリーズ

199279.description:
Yuri, a high school student obsessed with efficiency, gets his hands on a watch that can make time feel twice as fast. What starts with skipping boring classes soon leads to him speeding up his entire life.

(Source: MANGA Plus)

199280.description:
When a "window" crafted from special glass is mysteriously stolen... Manose, master of one-shots, presents an elegant mystery that gracefully untangles the threads of "time" and "heart."

(Source: MANGA Plus)

title.english: The Mystery of the Missing Slow Glass
title.native: 消えたスローガラスの謎
title.romaji: Kieta no Slow Glass no Nazo

199281.description:
Sakura is an elementary school student who absolutely loves cute things. After seeing her friend's puppy, she begs her mom to let her get a dog, but gets turned down flat. Sakura pouts about it, but then her grandpa makes her a deal. If she can take care of a bonsai tree for a whole year, she can have a dog...

(Source: MANGA Plus)

"Am I a beast or a human?"

This is the question that has plagued Leon his entire life. Born of a human mother and an ogre father, he has spent his days in hiding, away from those who would brand him an abomination. But after a threat to his village forces Leon to unleash the violent nature he had been suppressing, his existence becomes known to the world... With relentless hunters now on his tail, Leon must face his true nature and fight for his life against a world that demands his death.

(Source: Tapas)

Shinji, being the good friend that he is, decides to make a video message starring the voluptuous twins Yumi and Nami, for his recently-dumped friend, Naoto. But seeing the twins in their bikinis might just change the video message to a porno...

Twin Milf Additional Episode +1 is Tatsunami Youtoku's Doujinshi sequel to his popular "Twin Milf" series.

Won't you become my wife? ...A fake one.

"Your body is saying that it feels good." Giuliana, the daughter of a lower noble, is being asked to enter into a fake marriage with Renato, an intelligent, attractive, and princely man! He's being pushed into marriage after having a fling with the daughter of a famous family, so he wants Guiliana to act as his fake wife to make the other woman give up on him. Guiliana can't tell anyone about the truth of their relationship, and Renato treats her like a proper wife, giving her sweet touches and teaching her pleasure. She starts having feelings for him, but he says, "You don't need love to get wet when it feels good"!

(Source: BisouBisou Comics)

199285.description:
After his military service, Beom-Hwan returns to art school. His junior, Tae-Yeon, reveals a secret he'd wanted to keep hidden from his former schoolmates. Tae-Yeon notices a bounty on campus for ghost stories, and together with her physical education student, Ma-Ri, Tae-Yeon persuades Beom-Hwan, whose secrets she's uncovered, to solve the mystery. As they unravel the mysteries of the Burberry Man, animal abuse, and hidden cameras, Beom-Hwan and Ma-Ri begins to develop feelings for each other. Having never dated before, they struggle to figure out how to approach each other...

(Source: Kakaopage, translated)

199287.description:
I transmigrated into a novel, slayed the Demon King, and died—mission complete, right? I can go back to reality, right? Wrong! Turns out this flop story has a second part! Five years after I saved the day, I've reawakened in the same world as a haughty villainess. What's more, my old allies from Part One have all become awful people! I've got new rules and a new body, but it's still the same old mess...

The cruel prince's sweet seduction causes her to catch her breath...

"You're so cute. You're innocent and pure, and I'm going to dirty you..." Rivette's breath catches because of the sweet seduction from the cruel prince, Roy. But this marriage happened because of a secret contract. Rivette, a daughter of Duke Wilneria, offered herself to be the crown prince's wife in place of her older sister, who already had a lover. Every night, the perfect prince whispered sweet words of love to Rivette, but she couldn't shake off the feelings that she was simply a stand-in for her beautiful sister. However, Roy started showing possessiveness over her! "You're so cute, speaking that way. Let me have my way with you." However, Roy's hiding a deep secret, despite having made love to Rivette on their first married night!

On the way home from the game store, I died in a traffic accident - or so I thought, but it seems I've been reincarnated into the world of a training game!? I'm caring for my workaholic personal knight and secretly training with a tsundere righteous thief. As I'm enjoying my training life, he's somehow become more attached to me than I should...but this is a training game, right?

For some reason, Seo-Yeon begins seeing strange things. Ghosts appearing out of the blue are interfering with her work and love life, and she's on the brink of disaster! Hyun-U appears in a critical moment to help, but something feels off about this man who can banish ghosts with his fingertips.

"Can I help you?"

Hyun-U's gentle voice slowly shakes Seo-Yeon...

Her chilling yet sweet journey with the mysterious Mr. Lee begins now.

(Source: Peanutoon, translated)

Note: Includes three extra chapters.

199306.description:
The wedding of Im Na-Rim, my first love from six years ago, and Iri-Un, my best friend of 13 years. Iri-Un, the groom who had everything perfect, suddenly leaves Na-Rim, and Tae-Shin and Na-Rim are thrown into the past together, six years in the past!

One day I want to tell you, "I hate you to death."

Mizuho, ​​a former nurse, married Fumiya, who protected her from sexual harassment by a patient. Mizuho had been traumatized by infidelity, and even before they were married, she had told him that if he cheated on her, she would immediately divorce him. However, she was content with her picture-perfect, happy home with her husband, who everyone recognized as perfect.

However, Fumiya's actions, which are devoted to his wife and cherish their family, hide an incredibly despicable motive...!? Suspicions and women emerge one after another. What will Mizuho, ​​who is at the mercy of Fumiya's lies and schemes...?

The crazy adultery drama of a couple who are complete opposites, a diligent wife and a cheating husband, begins!!

(Source: CMOA, translated)

199312.description:
I was transmigrated in a novel that was written by my older sister. But.. the atmosphere of the novel is a little strange?

After My older sister got in a car crash, I was granted an opportunity to fulfill one wish in honor of her good deeds. So I chose to become the character my older sister cherished the most in a novel. I ended up possessing an antagonist named 'Satin', but the complications didn't stop there.. the main character 'Cain', the main protagonist who is a holy knight keeps interfering with me.

"Hey, why are you looking at me like that? It's giving me the creeps."

"Satin, just don’t talk to me. You might as well just go die."

Even though I was not really a big fan of novels. I still tried to dig into the uncovered mysterious secrets of the novel, and play as the 'faithful villain'. But.. my relationship with Cain started to become deeper than anyone else's.. And now everything's spiraling out of control..!!

"Satin! I really thought you were dead... So, I was planning to kill everyone..."

Kill? Seriously? Who would have thought that as a child, he was actually like a little kitten — who was feisty and stubborn?! This is really giving me a headache...
synonyms: The Atmosphere of the Novel Is in Crisis
The Mood of the Possessed Novel is in Crisis

199313.description:
Four YouTubers are invited to a haunted house to film. But the haunted house is fake. The invitation is a trap. They're not filming the house; the house is filming them and broadcasting them. Be careful. There's no escape. There are a lot of viewers, and some of them aren't even human.

(Source: Kakaopage, translated)

199314.description:
A thousand years ago, a war broke out between humans and gods, led by the "Su-Myeong-Jang-Ja." In this war, the only god who fought on the side of humans was Ogu. Defeated by the gods, Su-Myeong-Jang-Ja was split into ten thousand insects and scattered across the world, and Ogu-Shin was punished by being trapped in the cycle of reincarnation. A thousand years later, Ogu-Shin was reincarnated into the body of a young girl, Ba-Ri, and Su-Myeong-Jang-Ja also showed signs of resurrection. This horrific war must never happen again! Ba-Ri and Ogu embark on a journey to stop Su-Myeong-Jang-Ja's plans and find the God of Heaven and Earth...

Will Ba-Ri be able to save humanity and prove her own existence on this journey?

(Source: Kakaopage, translated)

199315.description:
Kanata sits in an empty classroom playing card games on his phone…until an earthquake traps him in an otherworldly dungeon ruled by a demon! But there, he discovers that he can summon the 300 cards from the game and invoke their powers! Can he fight his way to freedom with his card gaming skills?!

Their relationship feels inevitable, intoxicating, and fleetingly perfect. Until everything falls apart when Hwan takes Ji-An’s place in a hit-and-run accident. Desperate, Ji-An rushes to the hospital, only to be met with unfamiliar eyes and a cruel voice.

The new emperor, Yuan Shilong, was suspicious of her, but decided to marry her after she was divined as "a celestial maiden who will bring the world to the man she loves." Stella, the daughter of a count, underwent rigorous training to become a queen for 10 years, but her engagement was suddenly called off when the crown prince changed his mind. Not caring about anything anymore, Stella impulsively proposes marriage to Ludovic, the prime minister 20 years her senior and whom she admires. To her surprise, he proposes to her instead!

A doting age-gap love story between a young woman and a man she secretly adores!

Though everyone expected him to be conferred a legendary skill, Ragnus received an unknown skill called "Level Reset." The fatal ability to reset his level to 1 everyday was deemed "junk," and all at once he was reduced to a life of slavery. However, while being treated like a slave by those around him, Ragnus realized the great potential of his skill and decided to run away from home. Vowing to prove to the world the value of his cheat-level skill, he set out on a journey, but...

199339.description:
Jitarou is summoned to another world as one of the heroes. He is given the cheat-level recovery skill "Heal," which can cure any serious injury or curse. Jitarou uses the skill "Heal" to remove the curse "Absolute Obedience Mark" that controls the hero as a tool of war, but his desperate situation remains unchanged. However, the goddess Astrea suddenly appears and saves him from his predicament, and he is ordered to restore the goddess's faith and save the heroes who were summoned with the guidance of the evil god. Thus, Jitarou becomes an apostle of God and sets out on a missionary journey... but for some reason, he is worshipped instead of the goddess!?

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

199341.description:
There's always just one surefire way to win in a romantic comedy—simply saying "I like you!" The girls who have feelings for high school boy Izumi spent their days unable to take that first step forward.

[The School Idol Who Only Wants to Be Pampered When It's Just the Two of Them] Amane Amasaki. [Even Though I Was Disowned, My Former Fiancé Just Won't Leave Me Alone!] Hakua Shiragiku. [The Angel of the Academy... But the Devil Next to Her Is Surprisingly Easy] Haru Kasuga.

However, transferring into their class is Nanao Nanase, a seemingly ordinary girl who is actually a natural-born main heroine! Nano starts her fierce assault on Izumi with her shameless and straightforward approach.

"Izumi-kun, I like you. Please go out with me." "Here, say 'ahh'~♪" "Izumi-kun, you're the one who made me into this kind of girl, you know?"

In a panic, Amane and the others can't help but spring into action—"This girl... She actually did it!?"

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

But when she makes another wrong choice and Myung-joon agrees to fulfill her request, they end up kidnapping Ro-hee, a brilliant young genius, dangerously entangling all three of their lives. As the three confront secrets from the past and an inevitable tragedy, they must make impossible choices to survive. To get back at her serial-cheater of a fiancé, she and Leon pretend to have found true love with each other and break off Christine’s engagement. At home, where he has lived for years, he hears his wife's complaints, and at his part-time job, he hears Myeong-Tae's lamentations. 199561.description: In a far country ruled by a beautiful Duke who seems to have formed a peculiar relationship with his right hand, Lord Yuri, there are cases of unexplained deaths... they would involve a vampire according to the spreading rumour.

199562.description:
I'm afraid when you touch me.

Is this love? Or madness?

This is Japan in the near future, where the death penalty no longer exists. In a world of despair teeming with criminals, those known as “Tario” carry out bizarre acts of slaughter in the name of "revenge"!!

(Source: Akita Shoten, translated)

title.native: 背徳の聖者たち　Homme Fatal

199563.description:
Natalie, who used to be a daughter of a count, was forced to marry a nobleman in another country. She was treated cruelly by her mother-in-law and her servants. Even her husband challenged her to die on her own if she can. She did--thinking there were nothing good in the last ten years of her life.

When she opened her eyes, she was alive, back in her happy life which was ten years ago. If she tries, maybe she can change her fate...avoid the tragedy that awaits her. Natalie knows that soon she will lose her parents by a disease and a war, and she has to marry the Dark Knight, who saves this country... She won't let that happen again.

(Source: KADOKAWA)

title.native: 「死んでみろ」と言われたので死にました。

199564.description:
Abused by her family, Luana was sent to the monster-infested frontier in their place. She refused to die in vain! She promoted herself as a hidden user of light magic, eventually gaining recognition as a saint. "I'll definitely protect you," said Sieghart, the son of the Margrave, with his tsundere kindness, reminding her of the warmth of human beings...

And then, she reunites with her former family!? The Margrave is the only "family" I have!

A story of overthrowing the ruling elite, where an abandoned young lady finds true happiness!

(Source: KADOKAWA, translated)

Note: Includes five extra chapters.

title.native: 生贄として捨てられたので、辺境伯家に自分を売ります　～いつの間にか聖女と呼ばれ、溺愛されていました～

title.native: 生贄として捨てられたので、辺境伯家に自分を売ります　～いつの間にか聖女と呼ばれ、溺愛されていました～

199566.description:
Hyeonsu's life took a turn for the worse when a fire left him covered in burns, his father in the hospital, and their family smithy in a blaze. But just as he was losing hope, his friend had an idea: If he can't be a blacksmith in real life, why not try it in Ares, the AI-powered virtual reality game? With a bit of luck, he might make enough money there to pay for his father's hospital bills. With so many irons in the fire, can Hyeonsu rekindle the flame of his passion and rise from the ashes?

(Source: Tapas)

199567.description:
Aisha, a doctor working in a refugee camp, is hit by a bullet and wakes up to find herself as Padma, the crown princess and queen of 400 years ago! Padma was the first female doctor and was called the "Angel of the Battlefield," but in actuality, she was executed in the middle of the war.

The key to avoiding execution is to prevent the death of Edward, the crown prince, who is about to become ill in a year... Aisha is determined to use modern medical technology to save Edward, and to save Padma and the future of this country! Aisha is determined to do so, but it seems that there is a secret to his death that was not told in the historical facts...?
synonyms: Reincarnation Medical Care of Crown Princess Padma

title.native: 王太子妃パドマの転生医療「戦場の天使」は救国の夢を見る
title.romaji: Outaishihi Padma no Tensei Iryou "Senjou no Tenshi" wa Kyuukoku no Yume wo Miru

199568.description:
Dion has a secret lover—not in the waking world, but in his dreams. Every night, the visitor holds him and whispers lovingly into his ear; though the memories are hazy by the morning, the warmth of each embrace lingers. However, with the reality of marriage upon him, Dion decides to bid farewell to his imaginary lover. It's only a figment of his imagination, after all. But as misfortune starts to befall those around him, he realizes that there may be more to his dreams than he'd imagined...

(Source: Tapas)

199569.description:
On her way home, Butterfly encounters Logan, a water creature abandoned in an alley. Feeling a sense of urgency about abandoning him, and harboring a slight selfish attachment to Logan's body and face, she takes him home. Clearly, she intended to provide him with only temporary care. Just temporary care... But how could she, born a woman of integrity, turn down such a face and body?

(Source: Lezhin, translated)

synonyms: The Marquis Is the Martial Archduke
The Eldest Son of the Marquis House Is a Martial Artist

199571.description:
Ga-Ram, a promiscuous student on the Korea University campus, yearns to hook up with Jin-Hun, a classmate. He's always eager to get close, but Jin-Hun consistently ignores him...

While trying to figure out how to get Jin-Hun's pants off, Ga-Ram dreams of a strange old woman giving him a wish-granting magnet. The next day, when he encounters Jin-Hun, they're instantly hooked?! The two try various methods to break up...

"Hey, try it with me. Then we might break up."

(Source: Mr.Blue, translated)

199572.description:
Have you ever had sex?

As soon as he becomes an adult, Sung-Hyun spends the night with his childhood friend Ji-Won at his request. Sung-Hyun, who has been secretly in love with Ji-Won, tries to make things work out with him, but Ji-Won sleeps with other people as if nothing happened. Then one day, he discovers a rough mark on Ji-Won's body...

(Source: Mr.Blue, translated)

199573.description:
I definitely died a moment ago, I swear! Who are these people? What do they want from me?

(Source: Toomics)

199574.description:
The bartenders in Buuz can make your darkest dreams come true. All you have to do is drink the drink they make for you!

(Source: Toomics)

199575.description:
Heartless handsome man 'Choi Jeong-Won' X Dissolute trash man 'Baek Seon-Woo'

Choi Jeong-Won, who has returned to school, has trouble sleeping every night because of the moaning sound from his neighbor. Unable to bear it any longer, he goes to the house next door where a different man comes and goes every day to confront him... he finds out that the source of the moaning sound is Baek Seon-Woo, whom he loved in high school. Disappointed to see Jeong-Won living the same dissolute life as before, Seon-Woo keeps approaching Jeong-Won, who tries to avoid him...

Will the two be able to reach each other's true feelings?

(Source: Mr.Blue, translated)

199576.description:
At his first job, Ji-Won encounters Yeon-Su, his childhood friend's older brother and his first love. Seeing this as an opportunity, Ji-Won actively expresses his feelings for Yeon-Su, but he grows increasingly anxious about the lack of progress. Then, in a moment of inconsistency, he accidentally has a one-night stand with Yeon-Su. Yeon-Su misunderstands him as a slut, and their relationship becomes increasingly strained. Unconcerned, Ji-Won approaches Yeon-Su, who has misunderstood him.

"I like you, Manager."

Gu Ji-Won, a clumsy employee, embarks on a grand plan to win over Manager Baek Yeon-Su's heart!

(Source: MrBlue, translated)
synonyms: The Management Strategy of Unrequited Love

199578.description:
In the summer of 202X, a crisis befalls the majority of demons who have been absorbing human souls to fuel their magic. As more and more humans become more demonic than demons, there's no longer any need to sell their souls for demonic help. To overcome this employment crisis, demons prepare to change careers(?) into "mongma," capable of absorbing human energy without human consent. (Main character) Upir is no exception, but it's not as easy as he thinks. Eventually, (Main character) Cheol-Ho, a detective who is completely blocked by Upir, who tried to become a mongma through illegal means, appears...

(Source: Lezhin, translated)

Note: Includes three extra chapters.

199579.description:
Ji-Woo, a quiet college student, had been idolizing Da-Jung, a popular junior on campus. Da-Jung had also been developing feelings for Ji-Woo, a top student in his department, since their freshman year... Si-Won, who was watching from the side, simply couldn't stand this whole situation. Then one day, after a terribly difficult day, Si-Won reached out to Ji-Woo with a fatally tempting touch that was hard to resist...

"Your lips are so sexy."

"What time do you finish?"

(Source: Lezhin, translated)

Note: Part of Bomtoon and Lezhin's Dulbodaneun Sen Danpyeonseon (둘보다는 셋 단편선) Collection.

199580.description:
36-year-old single Heo Jae-Young promises a future with Sung Yoon-Woo, whom she met at a wedding, and decides to end her relationship with Sung Ha-Neul, a sex worker she had been seeing. However, the person Yoon-Woo introduced as his son was none other than Ha-Neul. After the marriage that proceeded without a hitch, the three of them live together. Jae-Young, who usually enjoys rougher sex, feels regretful about sleeping with the cautious Yoon-Woo. Ha-Neul, who senses Jae-Young's worries, makes an unexpected suggestion...

"Dad, you still don't know how to make Jae-Young feel, do you?"

(Source: Bomtoon, translated)
synonyms: รักซับซ้อน

199581.description:
"I like big ones!!"

Ji-Ho values ​​the size of a man's "sex" the most! The day after drinking with a big guy, his junior from school, Da-Bin, joins the company as a new employee. Ji-Ho even dated Da-Bin, who was close to her ideal type, but for some reason, Da-Bin ran away and left her behind... This man with a size(?) that he can't forget even after several years... I'm going to capture him!

(Source: Bomtoon, translated)

199582.description:
"It's been a while, Cha Ju-Ha?"

Rookie actor Cha Ju-Ha reunites with his high school classmate Yeo Hyun-Jin, whom he once hated and loathed, as the lead in a BL web drama. Ju-Ha, who's been cast as the lead in his first drama since his debut, is brimming with enthusiasm, but he keeps making mistakes because of Hyun-Jin, who keeps hovering around him...

Heartbroken by his repeated mistakes, Hyun-Jin suggests that Ju-Ha practice his script. But is this even allowed in script practice?

"Oh, huh... What are you doing?"

"You have to act like this to sound natural♡"

Why does Yeo Hyun-Jin's dick keep touching his butt?!

(Source: Mr.Blue, translated)

199583.description:
Young-Gil, the gangster boss who has been living a gang life for 20 years, unfortunately gets struck by lightning and falls into a coma, experiencing an out-of-body experience. Then, he hears from a dreamer he meets by chance that 'if you enter other people's dreams and gather energy, you can wake up from the coma.' So he starts looking for the dreams of his trustworthy subordinates who have been by his side...

Since when have you guys been imagining such erotic things about me?!

(Source: Mr.Blue, translated)

"Why is it that you have to be Signal's opponent?"

Signal, a rare disease that only a very small number of people are said to suffer from. Since it had nothing to do with me, I just struggled through my busy and difficult daily life... But as always, an ordinary day suddenly became worse than a nightmare. I shouldn't have answered that phone call... How did I end up getting involved with a man whose name I don't even know?

"Relax. Since you started first, you should have been able to handle it."

No, this is a lie. This is a dream. It can't be real!

199585.description:
The National Police Agency's “Special Cases Unit” specializes in investigating inexplicable supernatural incidents. The rookie investigator Yoshito Naruse is assigned to a new case, working alongside Kyubi Tenzen, nicknamed the “Fox Hunter," one of the most powerful civilian psychics in the country.

(Source: Dengeki Daioh, translated)

199587.description:
The virus FLOWER... This virus parasitizes humans, causing plants to grow and corroding the human mind and body. The infection spreads rapidly, resulting in many casualties. In this age, a way to deal with such a dangerous virus is required. To solve the case, a special unit consisting of former infected people with antibodies is formed, but the members are all a bunch of eccentrics...?!

(Source: Hakusensha, translated)

199589.description:
It is the early Showa period. Tsuyuko, a 27-year-old daughter of a kimono shop owner, dreams of taking over the family business of Tominoya, where she was born and raised, and repaying the kindness of her parents. She has turned down all prospective marriage proposals, intending to work hard on her own as the heir. But one day, Aki-chan, eight years younger than her and whom she loved like a little brother when she was little, returns home as a fine student at the Imperial University, and Tsuyuko's fate begins to change dramatically...

A precious and frustrating love story between the daughter of a kimono shop owner and a slightly clumsy younger student at the Imperial University.

(Source: Kodansha, translated)
synonyms: The Spring Storm in My Heart

199591.description:
I am currently attending my own funeral - in order to find the person who killed me.

Illustrator Yona Kaminaga is summoned to a retrospective exhibition of her mother, Maria Daichi, a genius painter who died young. When she reveals the existence of a painting that her mother left only to Yona, the looks on the others' faces change.. And that night, she is attacked by someone who tries to steal the painting...!? Will the "fake" discover the truth hidden within the painting?

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

199596.description:
Yuri lives with her younger sister Satsuki, and they get along well enough except for one thing that drives Yuri wild. Every night, she has to listen to Satsuki and her boyfriend Shou having sex on the opposite side of her bedroom wall. One day, when Yuri and Shou are left alone in the apartment, she gets a little curious…

(Source: Irodori Comics)

title.english: My Girlfriend’s Sister Wants Me Too
title.native: ヤラせてくれる彼女の姉ユリ(33)

199598.description:
What would you do for me? Despite possessing everything—money, looks, and popularity—

Su-Hyun, a delinquent, yearns for love, driven by an inferiority complex. He's exposed and trampled by Na-Yeon, the model student who's the polar opposite of him. Su-Hyun vows revenge, but gradually falls for Na-Yeon's unconditional love. Na-Yeon tests Su-Hyun's heart...

(Source: Naver, translated)

199599.description: People who live in an idyllic town where humans, youkai, and gods coexist. A warm omnibus story set in the Enshu region of Shizuoka prefecture, which colors the incidents related to the 72 seasonal changes that they cause with delicious food and seasonal scenery!

199600.description:
After her mother’s remarriage, Lee Hyeon-ah gains a new stepfather, Cha Kangjun: young, composed, and unsettlingly perfect. Though they share no blood ties and Hyeon-ah is already an adult, Kangjun’s attention toward her grows increasingly intense after the wedding. When her ailing mother leaves overseas for treatment, the house becomes a sealed world of watchful silences, unspoken threats, and boundaries that erode one by one. Trapped between fear, dependence, and a pull she doesn’t fully understand, Hyeon-ah must confront how far obsession can go when love, power, and secrecy twist into something dangerous.

(Source: Lezhin US)

The original Kuroko no basket one shot

Notes:
- Published in Akamaru Jump #32 Spring 2007
- Winner of Jump's "The Twelve Great Newcomers Manga Award (ジャンプ十二傑新人漫画賞)", which was held monthly from 2003 until 2007

synonyms: Teacher......Kissing is Outside the Scope of Class.

199605.description:
Yu and Ryosuke are colleagues who were once friends with benefits. The two lost contact when Ryosuke was posted overseas, but when Ryosuke returned to Japan, he got into trouble and had to rely on Yu... and for some reason, he ended up staying at Yu's house. He begins a strange life living under the same roof as his former sex buddy, a colleague, but a promise from the past keeps crossing Yu's mind...

"If you get serious, that's the end of it."

(Source: ShuCream, translated)

199607.description:
The year is 2039. The world has been taken over by AI and rewritten into an environment like an RPG game. While people have become players of this "real fantasy," Ji-san, a middle-aged man who was resurrected by the influence of AI control, spends his days diving deep into dungeons in despair. One day, Ji-san obtains a weapon called the Taming Sword, which allows him to capture monsters... This is the carefree fantasy of an old man who is obsessed with collecting monsters, neglecting to defeat the demon king or conquering the world

(Source: Natalie, translated)

199608.description:
When she becomes a "god" in another world, she's somehow doted on!?

One day, Honami Shirakabe, a woman in her 30s, suddenly finds herself unemployed. She's living a carefree life, having saved up some money, when a hole in a shoji screen made by a cat starts glowing and she hears the sound of prayer. Seeing that the problem seems to be troubling her, she Googles it on her smartphone and reads out the solution. She's thanked, worshiped, and eventually treated like a god! What's more, her success is so great that she's deemed a heretical cult, attracting the attention of Margrave Charles Freya, the "Bloodbeard Lord"...?!

A simple Google search solves any problem♪ This isekai romantic comedy finds her beloved by a sly, intimidating lord with a surprising twist!!

(Source: Futabasha, translated)

199609.description:
A heartbreaking, beautiful, and dangerous success story!

"Where did you go? Why did you suddenly disappear from my sight? Why!?"

A Japanese man, Luka, and a Korean man, Sung-Jun, who shared the same dream, were promised a debut through a project run by one of the industry's largest entertainment agencies. But before their debut could even begin, Sung-Jun suddenly disappears from Luka's sight. Their strong bond and pure promise are torn apart by Sung-Jun's irresistible fate and the dark side of the entertainment industry...

(Source: Futabasha, translated)

Yuki Shimomura, a "miss campus" student pageant runner up in her college days, blames others for her inability to make it to the top. She creates multiple accounts on social media sites to gain popularity, posting harassing messages on the accounts of popular models without batting an eye. Fed up with the sluggish increase of followers on her accounts, she decides to buy followers to "solve" this issue. What will come of someone so obsessed with the approval of others?

(Source: MangaPlaza)

199621.description:
It's been made into a novel! An anime! And, something no one expected, it's now been made into a vertical manga! With his sloppy white coat and dead fish-like eyes, Sakata Ginpachi has a personality and appearance that are hardly befitting of a high school teacher. His homeroom class, Class 3-Z of Gintama High School, is crammed with students with equally strong personalities, turning it into a terrifying amusement park. Is there really a future for such a problematic class?! The spin-off of the hugely popular comic and anime "Gintama" has landed on Jump Toon for the first time!

After chatting with a flower shop’s mascot part-time worker, Do-Hui suddenly finds himself on the radar of the school delinquent, Yang-Hyeon. Seeking comfort, he confides in the gentle person inside the bear costume, never suspecting it’s actually Yang-Hyeon himself. As misunderstandings and hidden crushes collide, a shy first love begins to bloom in the most unexpected way.

Junki Sakamoto, enjoying his ordinary college life, accidentally spies on a man masturbating in his room on a suspicious adult website called "Peepinghole.com." Sugimoto briefly ponders, "Is this okay?" His lower half is honestly aroused, and he begins masturbating. "Have I discovered a new taste?" After that, peeping on the website becomes a hobby for Sugimoto, and one day on campus, he encounters the man in the room, "Hishikawa Yuzuru."

199624.description:
Fang Wanjie took a risk and entered the “door” in order to save money for his girlfriend’s medical expenses. Unexpectedly, the high reward was a trap from the beginning. He was teased, humiliated, and beaten by his companions. He struggled to support himself, but was hunted down by tens of thousands of monsters. , gnaw. On the verge of death, he awakened his talent to save the day. When he was about to leave the ‘door’ to take revenge, he discovered that the key to the ‘door’ had been destroyed and he was trapped in the ‘door’ full of monsters. He wants to live! He wants to fight! He wants to become stronger! Even if he turns into a dead spirit, he will make life worse than death for these bastards!

(Source: Bilibili, translated)
synonyms: I Am the Angel of Death

199628.description:
"Like a child going hungry... I want to eat you up, time and time again."

Section Chief Koino has been stationed in this new position just a month earlier. He's notoriously known amongst the women in the office as an intense perfectionist, a cold and calculated businessman. Others in the office, like Nonoka Ando also find it hard to approach him... However, one day she finds her boss sitting out on a bench in the park during the lunch break, and to her surprise it turns out he makes his own neat lunches! Bit by bit, it becomes clear just how many little charming things Mr. Koino seems to be keeping to himself...!

(Source: MangaPlaza)

199629.description:
Kiriyama is a doll otaku who gets nervous and tense when people talk to her, making it difficult for her to communicate well at work. One day, she is shocked to discover that Minami (Ruby), a new employee, looks exactly like her beloved doll. Kiriyama gradually opens up to her, but she discovers her hidden hobby...

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

Note: Originally self-published on Twitter, was then licensed by Kadokawa for commercial release.

title.native: 君にかわいいと叫びたい

199630.description:
In a world where humans are oppressed as slaves to beastmen, a young boy named Haicha was born and raised as a soldier to fight against sea monsters. He lived alone through hellish days, never knowing when he might die. This young boy struggles in an unreasonable world, and a battle to rise above the rest begins!

(Source: Shounen Jump+, translated)

199631.description:
After being reincarnated into another world with a ton of cheats, the hero Hoshino Jurota easily defeated the Demon King. Now that his mission is over, his precious level is gradually dropping. For self-preservation and survival, he tries to curry favor with the royal family, but for some reason he ends up living alone with Princess Stella, who is there to watch over him! What will happen next?!

(Source: Comic Fuz, translated)

199632.description:
She feels suffocated by her tight bra and her husband's demands for her to be "feminine." Minori, who works at a post office, begins to search for the true nature of her frustrations together with a customer she's recently become interested in, a "braless lady," and her female friends with all sorts of lingerie issues.

(Source: Shodensha, translated)

title.native: ロマンスではないにしろ
title.romaji: Romance de wa Nai ni Shiro

199637.description:
"When I become a real writer, let's meet again."

Five years after I boldly confessed to Sujin, I became a truly popular writer. But I can't tell Sujin about the comics I draw. Because the comics I draw are... erotic comics!!!

(Source: Lezhin, translated)

199639.description:
Gyul, the protagonist of a divorced family, is shocked one day to discover that her mother is considering remarriage. Even the other family seems a bit strange...

(Source: Naver, translated)

199640.description:
Using her "PR skills," she aims for a happy ending with her favorite character from her previous life!

"The Saint threatened to destroy the country if I didn't break off our engagement," is what Cordelia, the villainess, tells her fiancé, Crown Prince Isaac. "I don't want to break off our engagement," she says, and Cordelia is not going to let the Saint hand him over to her! Then she discovers that Cordelia can use holy magic. If that's the case, then I'll become the Saint and set Her Highness free! With the vote to decide the Great Saint on the line, she puts her pride as a member of the PR department of her previous life on the line and works hard to produce herself★

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

199642.description:
Ever read one of those webtoons where an obnoxious male protagonist transmigrates into his favorite game, uses his knowledge of the plot to become ridiculously overpowered, and somehow gathers a harem along the way? Now, imagine reincarnating into that story! That's what happens to Nahyeon, but unlike the freewheeling teenager of a hero, she has no interest in becoming the main character. After all, it's way easier to stick right at his side and benefit from his grand plan! Or so she thought...

(Source: Tapas)
synonyms: How to Get On the Main Character's Flower Path
How to Walk the Protagonist’s Path to Glory

title.english: How To Ride the Hero's Coattails

199643.description:
Ho-Jin has long harbored a deep affection for Gil-Tae, the kind neighbor who has looked after him since childhood. Unable to confess his true feelings, Ho-Jin’s clumsy one-sided love remains a secret, until one night he finds himself masturbating over a drunken, sleeping Gil-Tae. Despite the significant age gap, what began as a hidden desire is about to cross a line from which there is no turning back, forever changing the innocent bond they once shared.

(Source: Lezhin US)

199644.description:
Lawyer Kim Dongwoo worked hard for all his life, yet he has achieved neither a family nor a career that brings true satisfaction. The lawsuits that fail to progress properly and a broken family have become overwhelming sources of stress for him. Perhaps because of this, Dongwoo suddenly becomes a primitive boy living 25,000 years ago. But it feels far too vivid and real to dismiss as just a dream. The life of primitive boy Dongwoo unfolds with his primitive family and the great wilderness of nature. How different is that life from the present one? Or perhaps, how similar?

(Source: Naver, translated)

199645.description:
Edwin Rocher and Leila Garwen grew up as childhood friends, but everything shifted the moment they became adults. When Edwin quietly asked, “Teach me how to touch myself,” Leila gave in to the request, thinking it would end there. Instead, he became addicted to the filthy pleasure Edwin fed him, and Leila found himself unable to escape the boy he once thought he knew so well. One night, Leila stumbles upon a creature with green eyes soaking in Edwin’s bath...a monster wearing the face he trusted most. In that moment, he realized he never truly understood what Edwin is, or what he wants. Caught between fear, desire, and the monstrous truth, Leila enters a den of corruption where escape is impossible and surrender may be the only path left.

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note: Includes two extra chapters.

199646.description:
Choi Hyeon-Gyeol is trapped in a hellish temporal prison. Every time the clock strikes midnight on the 15th, he is ripped back to the start of the previous day. Forced to repeat the exact same university assignments twenty times over, his sanity has worn dangerously thin. Pushed to his absolute breaking point by the monotony, Hyeon-Gyeol decides to abandon all caution and indulge in a wild, impulsive escape from his scripted life. This leads him to an unexpected, heated one-night stand with his fellow classmate, Lim Yeon-Jeong.

He falls asleep expecting to wake up to the same familiar nightmare once again. However, against all odds, the loop finally breaks. For the first time in what feels like an eternity, Hyeon-Gyeol opens his eyes to the fresh, uncharted morning of the 15th... with Yeon-Jeong right beside him.

(Source: Lezhin US)

199647.description:
At home he’s quiet and reserved but he cares for his wife and children more than anyone. At work he’s recognized as a responsible team leader. Yet the world calls him a “stubborn old man.” He values others’ opinions over his own happiness. That’s why Manager Kim obsesses over other people’s children, their cars and the houses they live in—more than his own life. Can Manager Kim, a big company employee who owns a home in Seoul, ever find true happiness?

(Source: Naver, translated)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.
synonyms: The Story of Manager Kim, Who Works For a Large Company in Seoul
The Dream Life of Mr. Kim
