In the shadows of Edo, under the ban on Christianity, lurks an ominous supernatural presence no one should approach. Give in to curiosity, and there will be no way back!

(Source: MANGA Plus)

title.native: ドスケベ巨乳女子が家族のいない連休にひたすらオナニーしまくる話
title.romaji: Dosukebe Kyonyuu Joshi ga Kazoku no Inai Renkyuu ni Hitasura Onanie Shimakuru Hanashi

199654.description:
Melfy has been abused by her family since she was a child and forced to cook as the "cook's daughter." One day, her fiancé, Shallow, suddenly breaks off their engagement. His new fiancée turns out to be Melfy's stepsister, Avaricia...! With nowhere to go, Melfy ends up working as a chef for the "ruthless marquis," Luke. Luke, known as the "magician of ice down to his heart," is transformed by Melfy's special cooking!

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

title.native: 婚約破棄された飯炊き令嬢の私は冷酷公爵と専属契約しました～ですが胃袋を掴んだ結果、冷たかった公爵様がどんどん優しくなっています～
title.romaji: Konyaku Hakisareta Meshitaki Reijou no Watashi wa Reikoku Koushaku to Senzoku Keiyaku Shimashita: Desu ga Ibukuro wo Tsukanda Kekka, Tsumetakatta Koushaku-sama ga Dondon Yasashiku Natteimasu

title.native: ねばねばネバーランド

199657.description:
Saint Rafina is suddenly told that her engagement is off. She was fed up with the selfish prince and thought it was just the right thing to do, but then Theo, the prince's aide, quits his job and starts working for Rafina! Rafina's dream is to open a tea shop in the cute house the king gave her as an apology, but soon after her engagement is broken off, she starts getting marriage proposals one after another...! A reversal of love story between a serious saint who wants to live a leisurely life♥

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

title.native: 婚約破棄された聖女はのんびり働きたい～突然皆様に求婚されてもお断りです！～
title.romaji: Konyaku Hakisareta Seijo wa Nonbiri Hatarakitai: Totsuzen Minasama ni Kyuukon Sarete mo Okotowari Desu!

199658.description:
Ryou Touse, 22 years old, found himself unemployed after an arson attack burned down the bento shop where he worked. With the help of those around him, he decided to open a food truck. One window side, a beautiful city of Japan, the other side.....Another world?! There's an imposing, handsome knight in full armor and a stunning beast-eared girl with an incredible figure!

"What the heck is going on with my food truck!?"

title.native: キッチンカー『デリ・ジョイ』―車窓から異世界へ美味いもの密輸販売中！―
title.romaji: Kitchen Car "Deli Joy": Shasou kara Isekai e Umaimono Mitsuyu Hanbai-chuu!

title.native: 「え、私がそっちなの！？」子犬系後輩彼女に食べられるカッコいい私
title.romaji: "E, Watashi ga Socchi na no!?" Koinu-kei Kouhai Kanojo ni Taberareru Kakkoii Watashi

199660.description:
1. Buzz-re! AV Engeki-bu (バズれ！AV演劇部); COMIC MILF 2025-10
2. Jimi de Sukebe na Hamedori-bu (地味でスケベなハメ撮り部); Comic MILF 2023-10
3-4. Houkago Dosukebe Nightpool (放課後ドスケベナイトプール); COMIC MILF 2024-08, 2025-04
5. Pashirare Kendou-bu: Onee-san no Shigoki (パシられ剣道部～お姉さんのシゴき～); COMIC MILF 2024-04
synonyms: 地味でスケベなハメ撮り部
放課後ドスケベナイトプール
パシられ剣道部～お姉さんのシゴき～

title.native: 放課後爆乳セックス部

199662.description:
Tax accountants, judicial scriveners, beauticians, social insurance and labor consultants... Intelligent and beautiful women with national qualifications. What are the shameful secrets these women reveal behind the scenes? A collection of exquisite short stories from the golden duo of Hazuki Kaoru and Takizawa Hiroyuki!

(Source: Weekly Manga Times, translated)
synonyms: Secret Night of a National Qualified Woman

title.native: 国家資格の女のナイショの夜
title.romaji: Kokka Shikaku no Onna no Naisho no Yoru

199663.description:
Komada Ryusei grew up as the daughter of a whiskey distillery. A university student with no connection to the alcohol industry, she aims to revive the legendary whiskey "Koma" in order to bring back her family, which has fallen apart due to financial difficulties, and for the people who love the alcohol they make.

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

title.native: 駒田蒸留所へようこそ～わかばが芽吹くまで～
title.romaji: Komada Jouryuujo e Youkoso: Wakaba ga Mebuku made

title.native: 大人になったら抱くからな
title.romaji: Otona ni Nattara Daku kara na

199665.description:
Raneko, a shy girl, and Kainu, a boy with a mysterious past. The two budding adventurers continue to challenge the Madara Tower, where the "treasure of the farthest reaches" lies.

(Source: Shogakukan, translated)

title.native: 東の魔女のあとしまつ

199667.description: Note: A compilation volume was published at Comiket 106.

199668.description:
Sumi bears a birthmark on her face. Meanwhile, the most popular student in her class seems to be having fun every day, even after catching the mysterious "transparency disease"...

(Source: MANGA Plus)

title.native: 入浴から始まる母との肉欲生活
title.romaji: Nyuuyoku kara Hajimaru Haha to no Nikuyoku Seikatsu

title.native: 妹としまくったのは酔ったせい
title.romaji: Imouto to Shimakutta no wa Yotta Sei

199674.description:
Liam Lucas returns home in glory as a revered war hero. Before departing for the battlefield, he had received a solemn promise from the Emperor: vast wealth, high honor, and the hand of the Imperial Princess in marriage. Armed with his triumphant return, Liam believes his miserable, downtrodden life as an Omega is finally over, and a glittering future lies ahead.

However, an unexpected obstacle stands squarely in his path: Frederick, the Crown Prince of the Empire and his childhood friend, fiercely opposes the upcoming royal wedding. Unbeknownst to Liam, Frederick harbors his own dark, possessive desires for the war hero, determined to stop the marriage at all costs and keep the Omega strictly for himself.

(Source: Lezhin US)

199675.description:
After the loss of its divine beast, House Moonreppe is on the verge of collapse. Desperate to save his household, the young Duke Edenver Moonreppe decides to summon a legendary beast to become their new divine beast. He’s prepared to take on whatever monster that is summoned, only to meet baby dragon Acille. Edenver is not sure such a small creature could be their new divine beast… until he discovers that this baby dragon packs quite the punch in terms of both power and loveability. Will Acille change Edenver’s life for the better in more ways than one?

(Source: Tappytoon)

title.english: Baby Dragon to the Duke’s Rescue

199677.description:
Rokuro stays at a Japanese inn where the beautiful hostess is said to provide excellent service!

(Source: Irodori Comics)

Note: Released at COMITIA134

199678.description:
Once a revered war hero, Ezekiel is reduced to a tortured man when he is blinded by poison. Ezekiel seeks to regain his eyesight and get his revenge against the woman who poisoned him, but he is utterly blind to the fact that she is the new maid in his manor, Rose. Having been previously blackmailed into harming Ezekiel, Rose is resolved to spend the rest of her life serving him. However, complications arise as the two of them grow closer. Can there be a happy ending for a relationship that was poisoned from the beginning?

(Source: Tappytoon)

199679.description:
They can't let go, but they can't control him...! To keep the handsome, freeloader Kita-kun (26), Touko (31, female), Minami (29, female), and Nishino (24, male) team up and come up with the answer: living in a share house where they can share their boyfriend!! They can't hope for 100%, and they can't stand 0%, so for now, being 33% each is fine. That's what they promised (or so they thought), and now the three of them and Kita-kun's life together, full of desire, begins!!

(Source: Futabasha, translated)
synonyms: 北くんがイケメンすぎて手に余るので、３人でシェアすることにしました。
Kita-kun ga Ikemen sugite te ni Amaru node, 3-nin de Share suru Koto ni Shimashita.

title.native: 北くんがかわいすぎて手に余るので、３人でシェアすることにしました。
title.romaji: Kita-kun ga Kawai sugite te ni Amaru node, 3-nin de Share suru Koto ni Shimashita.

199680.description:
Notes:
- All chapters were split into two parts in the original serialization and later combined in the volume release.
- Includes three extra chapters.

title.native: となりの同期の恋愛事情
title.romaji: Tonari no Douki no Renai Jijou

199681.description: Note: Originally published in Comic Yuri-Hime 2021 August issue.

title.native: 若君さんと鬼ギャルさん

199682.description:
Waking up in a fantasy novel where the universe bans her from using magic is just the first of many trials for Chris Dotten, a new professor at the prestigious Bedallua Academy of Magic. Bombarded with quests that each threaten to penalize her with death if she fails, Chris must survive her tenure as the teacher of the novel’s protagonist using whatever means necessary. However, with no magical solution at hand, her sole strategy is to roleplay as the teacher who is so powerful that using magic is unnecessary. Will Chris and her act survive until graduation day?

(Source: Tappytoon)
synonyms: The Fake Master Who Accidentally Became the Strongest

title.english: The Mighty Teacher is a Roleplayer
title.native: 欠陥転生者、最強教師になりきります
title.romaji: Kekkan Tenseisha, Saikyou Kyoushi ni Narimakirimasu

199683.description:
Rokuhara is at it again, this time using his special powers on his teacher!

(Source: Irodori Comics)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

199684.description:
Office worker Rokuro Rokuhara has a special ability and uses it to make his hot boss his personal plaything!

(Source: Irodori Comics)

Note: Includes two extra chapters.

199685.description:
Evangeline O’Hara has it all—wealth, privilege, and the most coveted engagement in the empire. But when tragedy strikes her family, the future duchess can no longer ignore certain truths. She is alone now, and this marriage won’t change that for the better. Duke Decarno von These has no doubts, as no other woman could be more perfect for the role. Things may be complicated now, but the conclusion is inevitable. Once they wed, the rest of these problems will vanish. Why should he think otherwise?

(Source: Tapas)
synonyms: 完璧な結婚を断る方法
Wie man eine perfekte Ehe ablehnt
How to Reject a Perfect Marriage

title.english: How to Reject the Perfect Marriage

199687.description:
If you got a second chance at life, what would you do differently? If Ignette's life was a Shakespearean story, the genre would be a tragedy. But when her death triggers a do-over for some of her life's most significant events, she is determined to approach each choice carefully, and with the most informed intentions. But with so many obstacles in the way, will she succeed in creating a different life than her last? Her pursuit of happily-ever-after with the Grand Duke is only about to begin.

(Source: Manta)

199688.description:
Tilda Vallinea Belmont, the elegant and perfect saint. The only daughter of a sacred family that produced a pope, Tilda was a perfect woman of both brilliance and beauty. However, burdened by the guilt of causing her mother's death in a childhood explosion of divine power, she lived a dull life. Tilda's husband, Windsor, suddenly demands a divorce, declaring his intention to marry her stepmother, Aclair. Aclair, who had been disguised as a kind stepmother, reveals her true colors to Tilda. Driven to the brink by Aclair's scheme, Tilda, consumed by a desire to live, makes a dangerous choice...

(Source: Naver, translated)

199690.description:
Ever since he was young, In-Seong had been the cause of girls around him fighting, for some supernatural reason. So he started work at a company he thought was mostly comprised of men, but he was totally wrong. At this company full of women, he finds himself in charge of the well-being of his female coworkers!

(Source: TOPTOON, edited)
synonyms: 福利厚生がエロい会社で働いています

199691.description:
Her fiancé, who is infatuated with the daughter who claims to be the reincarnation of a saint, tells her that he is breaking off the engagement. Duchess Sarah, exhausted by her relationship with her fiancé, accepts. Her furious parents sent her to a convent, but she was relieved to finally be able to live a quiet life. Just when she thought that peaceful days would return, her ex-fiancé appeared at the monastery and apologized to her. There is no way they will ever get back together, even if he says so now!

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

title.native: 婚約破棄した相手が毎日謝罪に来ますが、復縁なんて絶対にありえません！
title.romaji: Konyaku Haki Shita Aite ga Mainichi Shazai ni Kimasu ga, Fukuen Nante Zettai ni Ariemasen!

199692.description:
Serena is a poor aristocrat doing sewing work to help her indebted family. A marriage proposal comes from Marquis Harding, who is 30 years older, offering to take on all her family’s debts. She agrees for her family’s sake, and goes to Harding mansion — but instead of the Marquis, she meets his son Felix, admired by many women. It turns out her intended marriage is not with the Marquis himself, but with Felix. Serena expects Felix to be cold, but to her surprise, he begins to dote on her, showing intense affection.

(Source: Comico, translated)
synonyms: A deal with the marquis turns into a love story with his son

title.native: 30歳年上侯爵の後妻のはずがその息子に溺愛される
title.romaji: 30‑sai Toshiue Koushaku no Gosai no Hazu ga Sono Musuko ni Dekiaisareru

199693.description:
The protagonist, Kim Geon-Pyo, was left with her soul stolen by a rookie grim reaper's mistake. From that day on, everything in the world hates her. Especially that grim reaper!

(Source: Naver, translated)

199694.description:
A reclusive, lazy manga artist and a carefree editor with no life plan.

Two women approaching their 40s suddenly find themselves at the halfway point of their lives, thinking, "If I keep going like this, I'm in trouble!" They wonder about money, their health, beauty, and family... What should they do from now on to live the other half of their lives as happily as they have before?

This anti-aging essay tackles the anxieties and questions about aging head-on, starting with the first thing they think of!

(Source: Shogakukan, translated)

199695.description:
In her previous life, Narfalea, the daughter of the Silvenado Count family, tried to accuse her boss of embezzlement, but was falsely accused and died in prison. However, in her reincarnation, the Silvenado family has also committed numerous crimes, from assassinations to drug trafficking. This time, Narfalea succeeds in her accusation, and the entire family is beheaded. Even if it meant being executed, she wanted to uphold justice. However, for some reason, Narfalea is the only one who is not beheaded, and what's more, she is forced to marry Shinju, the cold-hearted head of the Ministry of Justice, who was supposed to execute her, in name only!

(Source: Bunkasha, translated)
synonyms: The Transmigrated Lady Condemned to Death Enjoys Her Third Life as the Stern Minister’s Wife!

title.native: 死刑が確定した転生令嬢は、冷徹長官の妻になって三度目の人生を謳歌します！
title.romaji: Kakutei Shita Tensei Reijou wa, Reitetsu Choukan no Tsuma ni Natte Sandome no Jinsei wo Ouka Shimasu!

199696.description:
Notes:
- Includes the two-part short story "Please, Please, Please (プリーズ・プリーズ・プリーズ)".
- Includes one extra chapter.

199697.description:
After just starting high school, Yuri catches the eye of a “pack of wolves.” Yuri, a first-year high school student, finally enrolls at Hibari Technical High School with the dream of someday building “a really cool bike.” But on the very first day, she gets dragged into the fight of one of the four notorious second-year troublemakers, Roa Akamatsu...! What’s more, Yuri seems to be hiding something...! A coming-of-age romance about a tomboy heroine who gets tangled up with four boys with sketchy reputations!!

(Source: K MANGA)

199702.description:
Susan Yan, wronged by her ugly appearance, was rescued by a mysterious black suit man when she jumped off the building. He made a deal with her. As long as she could finish the tasks he gave, he would gave the life she wanted, including the beautiful appearance of Eve. Since then, Susan Yan gradually degraded herself. She abandoned her talents and became a maneater...

(Source: WebComics)
synonyms: Learning of Love, Beauty and Revenge

title.romaji: Ai Yu Meimao De Fuchou Yanxi

199703.description:
Maeng Jeong-Jin, a baseball coach, has been kicked out of his team. With the help of a senior, he finally joined the Sun Devils, but the team is now in the abyss of factional strife. His only hope for survival is politics. To survive in a baseball world where skill alone is insufficient, Maeng Jeong-Jin embarks on a journey of "politics."

(Source: Kakaopage)

title.native: 恐怖漫画短編集 孤独

199705.description:
The Hero guards the empire in times of war but is sealed away when peace prevails, making her life an incessant cycle of fighting and slumber. That is, until she wakes up as Roshanne Leilaten, a meek noble lady looked down upon by even her own servants. Unwilling to give up the freedom she so yearns, Roshanne conceals her true identity as she investigates how to permanently break the seal that binds her to the emperor. But can a girl who's used to leading with her fists navigate high society?

(Source: Tapas)
synonyms: The Princess is Still The Strongest
Even if I Hide My Power, the Noble Lady Is the Strongest
The Young Lady’s Strength Surpasses All
Even if she hides her power, the young lady is the strongest

title.english: The Strongest Lady Hides Her Strength

199706.description:
Mukaihara-kun, who isn't good with girls, suddenly becomes close to the androgynous Kotake-san! The two popular students cause chaos at school!

(Source: Hakusensha, translated)

1. Kotake-san to Mukaihara-kun (小竹さんと向原くん)
2. Yamada to Suihei-sen (山田と水平線)
3. Hanaichimonme (花いちもんめ)
4. Higan Nite (彼岸にて)
5. Fugitto Amor (フギット・アモール)

title.native: 小竹さんと向原くん─椎名橙短編集─
title.romaji: Kotake-san to Mukaihara-kun: Shiina Dai Tanpenshuu

199707.description:
Yuni, who graduated from art school without being cured of her "I'm special" disease, faces a society far harsher than a winter cold wave! Realizing that even living an ordinary life isn't easy, let alone being special, Yuni dreams of becoming an "ordinary" office worker, riding the hellish subway, rubbing her sleepy eyes, and drinking Americano...

"Life begins with admitting I'm a loser."

This is the bittersweet, sweet, and spicy story of a former artist and newbie in the workforce. When will Yuni finally be able to live an "ordinary life"?

(Source: Kakaopage, translated)

title.native: 黒崎くんの言いなりになんてならないS
title.romaji: Kurosaki-kun no Iinari ni Nante Naranai S

199709.description: A love story between a fallen divine dragon and the lonely crown prince, set in an ancient Asian setting.

199710.description:
Ever since they were kids, Kaoru and his childhood friend Toyoko have had one rule: the loser in judo buys the winner a meal. But now that they’re in high school, Kaoru just can’t keep up—Toyoko only gets stronger every year, and he’s stuck paying the bill.

After yet another crushing win, Toyoko teases him with a snide remark… and Kaoru finally snaps.
He stakes everything on a final match: “If I lose this time, I’ll buy you meals for the rest of my life!”

A judo bout to decide their future — rivalry, pride, and maybe something more are all on the line!

(Source: Shonen Magazine, translated)

199711.description:
I was proud to be the biggest tsundere fan in the world until the day everything changed: when I woke up from uneasy dreams to find myself turned into a staff and buried in a forest! Fortunately for me, a narrow-eyed, silver-haired beauty saved me. I tried to thank her, only for her to say...it’s not like she saved me for my sake, or anything! What is that but the textbook line of a tsundere?! This perfect tsundere specimen is apparently Stella, a student of the Saint Antohsa Academy and the owner of a certain holy magic staff—me. Guess I’ll have to cheer her on for the rest of my life! But wait, why am I a staff, anyway? When I visit the Goddess who rules over this world in the hopes of becoming human again, she tells me I need to kill Stella, the so-called evil witch, to have my wish granted! I have to choose between my shy beloved and world peace? Well, that’s an easy one... This is the first volume of a school-life fantasy where a staff—that’s me—and a tsundere girl change the world!

(Source: J-Novel Club)
synonyms: The Goddess Orders to Kill the Tsundere Witch

title.english: The Goddess Says, "Kill the Tsundere Witch!"
title.native: ツンデレ魔女を殺せ、と女神は言った。
title.romaji: Tsundere Majo wo Korose, to Megami wa Itta.

199712.description: Koreya Takane, a famous scientist, had enough of the constant obligations required by his position when all he really wants is to be left alone with his work. That's how, in order to satisfy his taste for solitude, he build up a mechanical clone of himself... But what if it becomes impossible to distinguish the replica from the original man in the end?

title.native: 愛されなかった社畜令嬢は、第二王子（もふもふ）に癒やされ中
title.romaji: Aisare na Katta Sachiku Reijou wa, Dai Ni Ouji (Mofu Mofu) ni Iyasare Naka

title.native: ラブカレ　極上メンズ読本！スーツ男子
title.romaji: Love Kare Gokujou Men's Dokuhon! Suits Danshi

199715.description:
Countess Rilla is extremely poor! Without the backing of her fiancé, the Marquis of Moritz, she's on the precipice of ruin! But at the entrance ceremony of the Royal Academy of Magic, she witnesses her fiancé Klaus having an affair with another girl! When she asks Klaus about the affair, he mocks her as "plain and boring," and declares that he'll break off the engagement after she graduates from the academy! If her parents lose Klaus' support, she'll be out on the street!

No, I'm trying! I refuse to get back together with the morally harassing marquis's son! I'm going to become an alchemist for my independence! But the strange student from the empire, Ares, also appears...!

Alchemy is the art of freedom!

title.native: 「地味でつまらない」と捨てられたので、地道に錬金術師を目指します！〜堅実令嬢は婚約破棄後に幸せになる〜
title.romaji: "Jimi de Tsumaranai" to Suterareta node, Jimichi ni Renkinjutsushi wo Mezashimasu!: Kenjitsu Reijou wa Konyaku Hakigo ni Shiawase ni Naru

199716.description: A kind prince with strange red eyes who had been locked up by his uncle decides to end his misery... without knowing the grief it'll cause to his brother. He suddenly reappears 13 years after but what if he really has become the “Prince of Monster” as he used to be called?

199717.description:
Suzune is known as a “cursed child”, said to mislead even the kindest of people. Several years ago, a once-gentle neighborhood priest went into a frenzy at the sight of her blood, leaving Suzune with a deep wound on her back. From that day forward, she was branded with the stigma of being “cursed.” Burdened with debt, her family chose to sell Suzune—not her twin sister—to a pleasure district island. There, she works as a maid, forced to wear a mask to suppress her "curse," and endures daily mistreatment...

One day, Yakumo, the head of a powerful conglomerate who controls the sea around the island, visits. Rumors say that “any courtesan chosen by Yakumo has no memory of sharing his bed.” Drawn in by Suzune’s unique “scent”, Yakumo demands to take in the girl who was abandoned by her family…

Thus begins a Japanese-style Cinderella love story, born from a marriage to a vampire!

title.native: 吸血鬼へ嫁入る日～少女が冷酷夫に愛された記録～
title.romaji: Kyuuketsuki e Yomeiru Hi: Shoujo ga Reikoku Otto ni Aisareta Kiroku

199718.description:
The story of "Zundamon TV!" begins when Zundamon, who has lost her memory, shows up at the home of high school girl Tohoku Zunko. In order to find clues about Zundamon, who remembers nothing but her name, Zunko's younger sister Kiritan suggests uploading a video of Zundamon online. The story follows Zundamon and friends as they work hard to broadcast "Zundamon TV" in an effort to regain her lost memories.

(Source: Natalie, translated)

199719.description:
Kuromaikai, a tengu, was once famous as a legendary ayakashi. However, his shrine is now in ruins, and he has fallen so far into decline that even his servants have fled. "It's all humans' fault!" he says, determined to restore his former glory, he descends the mountain and visits an old demon who has made a fortune in the human world. "If you can complete the test, I'll lend you my strength," he is told, and tasked with raising a human baby with his nemesis, the fox demon Miyakineina...!?

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

title.romaji: Tengu to Kitsune, Chichi ni Naru

199721.description:
When a mother of three collapses from raising her children alone, she is reincarnated as Olivia, the villainous daughter from her favorite novel, "Twilight LOVE"! Olivia was a clingy duchess who was in love with her fiance, the crown prince. However, Olivia's son is stolen from her by a saint from another world, and her atrocities against the saint are discovered, leading to her execution. In the novel...

No, no, no, I'm sick of marriage! I want to save the children more than anything! So why is the crown prince pursuing me...?

A romantic fantasy between the incredibly tolerant, child-loving duchess Olivia (the voice actress raised three children!) and the slightly pushy, self-centered, high-spec crown prince (though why does he have the eyes of an abandoned puppy?)!

(Source: Kodansha, translated)
synonyms: A Mother Who Is Reincarnated as a Villainous Lady Reforms Her Child-Rearing Methods.

title.native: 悪役令嬢に転生した母は子育て改革をいたします ～結婚はうんざりなので王太子殿下は聖女様に差し上げますね～
title.romaji: Akuyaku Reijou ni Tensei Shita Haha wa Kosodate Kaikaku wo Itashimasu: Kekkon wa Unzari na node Outaishi Denka wa Seijo-sama ni Sashiagemasu ne

title.native: 悪役令嬢に転生した母は子育て改革をいたします ～結婚はうんざりなので王太子殿下は聖女様に差し上げますね～
title.romaji: Akuyaku Reijou ni Tensei Shita Haha wa Kosodate Kaikaku wo Itashimasu: Kekkon wa Unzari na node Outaishi Denka wa Seijo-sama ni Sashiagemasu ne

199724.description:
The Hero and her trusty Sage have defeated the evil Draconic Lord and taken away the Magistone, the source of his power. He's still following them around and pestering them to give it back, but without the Magistone, he's no match for them. Meanwhile, the two women are busy investigating a haunted graveyard. The Dark Lord is powerless and his minions are gone, but strange horrors still lurk in the darkness below the earth. Caught in the grasp of countless writhing tentacles, the Hero and Sage may finally find themselves outmatched...

(Source: Irodori Comics)

title.english: The Hero, the Sage, and the Former Dark Lord
title.romaji: Yuusha to Kenja to Moto Maou

199726.description:
Michelle, head saint and fiancée to Crown Prince Alphonse, spends her days trying to fulfill unreasonable requests from nobles and working to maintain the protective barrier surrounding the land. She barely has time to eat or sleep and on top of that, she is the target of envy from those around her and is called “the cruel saint.” A gaunt Michelle attends a party thrown by the prince, but what awaits her there is the calling off of her engagement and the termination of her role as head saint. When she hears the news, she shouts with joy in front of the smug prince! However, the king, concerned for the future of the country, tries to keep Michelle from leaving by ordering her to marry a man infamously known as “the lecherous marquess."

(Source: K MANGA)

title.english: From Ditched to Happily Hitched! Do You Regret It? Who Cares!
title.native: 捨てられ聖女は契約結婚を満喫中。後悔してる? だから何?
title.romaji: Suterare Seijo wa Keiyaku Kekkon wo Mankitsuchuu. Koukai Shiteru? Dakara Nani?

199727.description:
This summer, I’ll be keeping an elementary school girl… as a cat.

Natsume Kouji, your average high school boy, finds himself spending summer vacation “keeping” a 5th grade girl as his pet cat.

—Why?

Because that very 5th grade girl, Fumika Yukimi (currently cosplaying with cat ears), has awakened an ability to see future news reports. According to her premonition, unless she behaves like a “house cat” in my home, she’ll be killed by a serial murderer at the end of summer vacation.

Trauma savants—girls who have gained supernatural powers in exchange for their painful pasts. Yukimi’s power is the real thing, so I have no choice but to properly treat her like a beloved pet. Of course, things can’t stay like this forever.

To overturn Yukimi’s destined death—and to escape from this situation where I myself might get reported to the police and socially executed—I must join forces with Tsukiko Kyouno, the fiery, tsundere, overly lustful beauty who once awakened her own “ability” and narrowly escaped a serial killer. Together, we have to solve the case that’s currently shaking the town: the “Midsummer Elementary School Girl Chocolate Serial Killing.”

But as we continue our investigation, one troublesome incident after another comes crashing down on us—
With the situation changing as quickly as a cat’s eyes, is there really a path for us to survive?

A prophecy-gifted girl who became a cat to escape death, and the summer we run through together— Summer × Love × Suspense!

(Source: Gagaga Bunko, translated)
synonyms: 少女事案～炎上して敏感になる京野月子と死の未来を猫として回避する雪見文香～
少女事案 2～白スク水で愛犬を洗う風町鈴と飼い犬になってワンワン吠える夏目幸路～
少女事案 3 ～バクハツして時を駆ける夏目娘と、小五の娘を持つ高校生の夏目幸路～

199728.description:
Our main character comes home after a long day to be met with a strange light and a beautiful, and even stranger, girl who wants nothing more than to bring him “happiness”.

(Source: Irodori Comics)

199729.description:
On her first day of marriage, Empress Etoile wakes up from a nap and regains her memories of her first life. It is a future ruined by being loved by Emperor Alfred. She must not love him. In this life, she struggles to avoid becoming close with him, but his doting hand never lets up...!?

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

title.native: 死亡確定陛下を救いたいのに、本人が溺愛で邪魔してきます!
title.romaji: Shibou Kakutei Heika wo Sukuitai no ni, Honnin ga Dekiai de Jama Shitekimasu!

199730.description:
In a world where everyone is given a skill when they turn 18, everyone had high hopes for Arios, the son of a sword saint. Everyone thought he would definitely be given the "Sword Saint" skill... but the skill he was bestowed with was "Cheat Code Manipulation." This unprecedented skill was treated like trash, and Arios was banished from his family home. However, with this useless skill, he was able to manipulate extraordinary cheat codes! His childhood friend, the princess, joins him, and he unwittingly unleashes his unrivaled power in his new land!

(Source: Gaugau Monster, translated)

title.native: おい、外れスキルだと思われていた《チートコード操作》が化け物すぎるんだが。
title.romaji: Oi, Hazure Skill dato Omowareteita "Cheat Code Sousa" ga Bakemono Sugirun daga.

199731.description:
"To spill our blood is to owe us life in return."

Long ago, in a distant land...

A princess, loathing the fate of an arranged marriage, fled her kingdom with her beloved knight. But their escape was short-lived. Captured by vengeful barbarians, she was faced with a cruel choice.

"Become my wife, and I shall spare your knight."

To protect the man she loved, she became the unwilling bride of a barbarian lord. Stripped of her dignity, she endured endless nights of humiliation at the hands of his merciless kin.

Before her helpless lover's eyes, she was broken, body and soul -- pleasure wrought upon her until all hope of the future she once dreamed of faded away.

A tragic tale of an innocent princess, punished for her father's sins; a reckless knight, blind to danger; and a brutal fate neither could escape.

(Source: DLsite, translated)

title.english: The Barbarians' Bride: The Fallen Princess
title.native: 蛮族の花嫁～堕ちた姫君～
おい、外れスキルだと思われていた《チートコード操作》が化け物すぎるんだが。
title.romaji: Oi, Hazure Skill dato Omowareteita "Cheat Code Sousa" ga Bakemono Sugirun daga.

199735.description:
After rescuing a black cat, she is reincarnated as Alice, the villainous young lady from a novel she read in her previous life. Her husband treats her coldly, and if things continue as they are, she is destined to commit suicide.

"I'll use him to survive!" ...thinking that, she plays the villain, but then he asks her, "Would you like to enter into a contract marriage with me and become my figurehead wife?"

And what's more, he dotes on her—!? A one-year contract marriage to be loved by a cool, handsome duke!

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

title.native: 愛されない悪役令嬢に転生したので開き直って役に徹したら、何故だか溺愛が始まりました。
title.romaji: Aisarenai Akuyaku Reijou ni Tensei Shita node Hirakinaotte Yaku ni Tesshitara, Naze da ka Dekiai ga Hajimarimashita.

199737.description:
Everyone recognizes my little sister as a "saint." But to me, she might be a "devil."

Everyone praises my little sister, who attends church every day and actively does charity work, calling her a "saint." But because of this, our finances are always in trouble. My sister has donated all the money I've saved to the church. Then a handsome man appears, and he says he's an emissary from the kingdom, looking for a saint. Please, please, take my little sister with you. Right now!

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

title.native: 聖女様をお探しでしたら妹で間違いありません。さあどうぞお連れください、今すぐ。
title.romaji: Seijo-sama wo Osagashi deshitara Imouto de Machigai Arimasen. Saa Douzo Otsure Kudasai, Imasugu.

199738.description:
Rose, a saint who was supposed to have been executed after being falsely accused by her scheming sister, suddenly finds herself back in time, two years before her death. Now given a second chance, she aims to go where her "oshi" is! To save her favorite magician, Guiltia-sama, the villainous saint will use all her cunning to save him! The ultimate "oshikatsu" otherworldly love story begins!

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

title.native: 悪役聖女のやり直し ～冤罪で処刑された聖女は推しの英雄を救うために我慢をやめます～
title.romaji: Akuyaku Seijo no Yarinaoshi: Enzai de Shokei sareta Seijo wa Oshi no Eiyuu wo Sukuu Tame ni Gaman wo Yamemasu

199739.description:
Jane came to Hainan to relax after losing both her job and her boyfriend. She made the acquaintance of Tyler, a young CEO of an tech company and because she was embarrassed to say that she is unemployed, she told him that she is an employee of a real estate company without knowing the real owner was standing right next to her. But not only did he not expose her lie, but also told everyone that she was his assistant... In ten days in paradise, Jane made many wonderful experiences as an "assistant" and meanwhile, love has also quietly sprouted...

(Source: WebComics)

199740.description:
Tilia is a "talentless" girl born into a family of counts who have wielded magical powers for generations. She is despised by her family and treated like a servant, but for some reason, a cute divine beast becomes attached to her. Duke Alvis sees this and thinks she may have some kind of talent. Little by little, the two grow closer... This is the story of how an oppressed girl discovers her true abilities and is saved.

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

title.native: 神獣騎士様の専属メイド～無能と呼ばれた令嬢は、本当は希少な聖属性の使い手だったようです～
title.romaji: Shinjuu Kishi-sama no Senzoku Maid: Munou to Yobareta Reijou wa, Hontou wa Kishou na Seizokusei no Tsukaite Datta You desu

199741.description:
A century ago, Agito Yatsurugi and his comrades saved humanity by slaying the six dragons that invaded Earth through magical gates. As he lay dying, he learned the dragons would return in 100 years to awaken the dragon god and end the world. Granted a second chance, Agito awakens in the body of Agito Mitsurugi, a powerless F-rank student at a magic academy. With time running out, he must rally new allies--some tied to his past--to face the reborn dragons and stop the coming apocalypse once and for all.

(Source: WEBTOON)
synonyms: The Return of the Genius Sword Saint ~I’m a Failure with Zero Mana but Actually the Strongest~
Le retour du génie de l’épée

title.native: 帰ってきた天才剣聖〜魔力ゼロの落ちこぼれなのに実は最強〜
title.romaji: Kaettekita Tensai Kensei: Maryoku Zero no Ochikobore na no ni Jitsu wa Saikyou

199743.description: A childhood friend, Haru, who is 10 years older than me, whom I met when I was a child. Ren, a childhood friend from the same class who found himself by my side. This is a story of first love between these two childhood friends and myself, Mei Tachibana.

199744.description:
Falma, the daughter of Count Helqvist, whose family has for generations commonly acquired the skill of summoning spirits, disappoints her parents when she acquires the skill of using insects at the age of 10 and is confined. Afterward, having regained her memories of her previous life as a Japanese farmer's wife, she uses her memories and the knowledge gained from her books to escape from her home. She starts growing vegetables to save money, but...? A love fantasy of a count's former daughter who abandons her home and aims to become independent in order to find happiness!

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

title.native: 親から見捨てられました。自力で生き抜いてみせます。
title.romaji: Oya Kara Misute Raremashita. Jiriki de Ikinuite Misemasu.

199746.description:
One day, Sierra Digitalis recalls her memories from her past life. She discovers that she was a dull office lady reincarnated as a "stalker character in an 18+ otome game"! To escape the scenario, she uses the power of a spirit to meet a handsome man unrelated to the game, and they fall in love...or so she thought, but it turns out that the man she loves has a future as the "King of Impurity" who will destroy the world...!?

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

title.native: 伯爵令嬢はヤンデレ旦那様と当て馬シナリオを回避する!!
title.romaji: Hakushaku Reijou wa Yandere Danna-sama to Ateuma Scenario wo Kaihi suru!!

199747.description:
"Humiliating, isn't it? To be touched by a man other than the one you love..."

In the past, Stella's family and her home were stolen from her. As she fled with her servants, she was rescued by none other than Count Schwef -- the man who was responsible for her plight in the first place. And so she came to live in the home of her father's bitter rival, all the while, secretly planning her revenge... Until the count's eldest son, Michel, took a liking to her.

He wasn't a particularly capable man, and was rather spoiled, so Stella became his caretaker. Eventually, even the count became like family to her. With Michel's social debut looming, our heroine decided to leave the mansion. But on the night of Michel's debutante ball, he summoned her... and his entire demeanor changed.

After overcoming various hardships and telling one another their feelings, they officially became a couple.

It's been one year since then, and Count Schwef is about to hold a ceremony for Stella, and after so much time together, she's prepared to accept a proposal of marriage from Michel. The good times are not to last, however...

A mysterious man with an army of sorcerers at his call enters the manor of House Schwef and sweeps Stella away despite her protests.

Stella and her captor arrive at the royal palace, where Stella is kept prisoner. This man seems to know more about Stella than she does...

"10 days from now is your coronation ceremony, Your Highness... I expect this will be uncomfortable, but I ask that you bear it."

Trapped in bed, his cold hands creep across her body, but no matter what he does, she can't shake the feeling that she knows him...
synonyms: The Gentle Breaking of a Failed Villainess ~10 Days with a Doting Sorcerer~

title.native: 悪役になれなかった追放令嬢は甘く優しく蕩かされる～呪術師とふたりきり、溺愛の10日間。～
title.romaji: Akuyaku ni Narenakatta Tsuihou Reijou wa Amaku Yasashiku Toroka Sareru: Jujutsushi to Futarikiri, Dekiai no 10-nichikan

199749.description:
Ada, the daughter of the Duke of Lafine, has been appointed by the king to be the tutor for Steven, the first prince of the renowned Kingdom of Fierte, known for his perfection. However, when she meets the prince, she finds him exhausted from work, listless and sloppy. Since childhood, perfection has been expected of the prince, who has worked too hard, so she decides to teach him how to "take a break"...!

The prince's tutor's daughter finds relief for his tiredness. A soothing, otherworldly love story begins!

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

title.native: 疲れた王子様と教育係のご令嬢の話
title.romaji: Tsukareta Oujisama to Kyouikugakari no go Reijou no Hanashi

199750.description:
Arrietty aims to become the highest ranking singer, the "Shrine Maiden Princess," but is sadly defeated. Then, she is proposed to by Joshua, Margrave of Carving, but the engagement is suddenly broken off. After all that has been said and done, Arrietty is then ordered by Carving to be sent out as a priestess...!?

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

title.native: 二番手の女 歌姫としての誇りを胸に、最後のご奉公をいたします
title.romaji: Nibante no Onna: Utahime Toshite no Hokori wo Mune ni, Saigo no Gohoukou wo Itashimasu

199751.description:
"Unexpected!!," a boy band competition show told from the perspective of member Zhan Xingyao, saw a surge in fans thanks to a pre-determined collaboration with a former member he admired. He stated that he was innocent and had absolutely no ulterior motives. Until...

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

199752.description:
His looks are -255, touching girls causes him pain, and sexual acts will literally tear him apart—that’s the price Yoshioka Shigeru paid to become an overpowered god after he ended up inside a game. Though he’s ugly as sin, he has loyal friends who have founded an employment agency alongside him, except that the true goal of the agency is to defeat an evil organization. As they work towards their goal, they discover that one of their friends, Riese, was hiding a secret… What awaits them on this new adventure?!

(Source: Manga UP!)

title.native: ブサメンガチファイターSSS
title.romaji: Busamen Gachi Fighter Sugoi Side Story

199753.description:
Dogs age faster than humans. Their fur changes and their eyes turn white. This moving omnibus essay depicts the final days of five pairs of elderly dogs and their owners as they live with these changes.

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

title.native: 老犬とわたし～妹は64歳になりました～
title.romaji: Rouken to Watashi: Imouto wa 64-sai ni Narimashita

199754.description:
Umeichi Kousaka is known as a young genius in the world of Japanese-style painting. However, he is also known for his fearless and haughty personality which has earned him the nickname "King."

One day, a young boy named Hikari suddenly appeared at Kousaka's house. Hikari doesn't have a place where he can be himself in neither his school nor his home. He is also totally afraid of everything around him. Then one day, the two met with an accident after which they found that they have swapped bodies?

(Source: Kodansha, translated)
synonyms: The King and the Boy Have a Secret

title.native: 王様と少年は秘密を持っている
title.romaji: Ousama to Shounen wa Himitsu wo Motteiru

199755.description:
After being reincarnated in a game world, Ravie Heathfen, has been forced to play the role of the villainous noble lady after the game's heroine placed a slave curse on her. When the magic suddenly came undone, she gained back her bodily freedom and also memories of her past life but she has to make sure that the heroine doesn't find out or she'll lose her head! She wants to escape immediately but it's just impossible with the horribly skinny state her body is currently in. So for now, she'll just have to settle with eating porridge first and start building back her physical strength! But her fiancé the prince, the muscular knight, and others would unexpectedly come and start quarreling with her. It seems that our skinny young lady's escape plan will be filled with plenty of great difficulties!

(Source: Kodansha, translated)
synonyms: Considering I'm Being Forced into the Villainous Rich Girl Role, I Will First Eat Some Porridge.

title.native: 強制的に悪役令嬢にされていたのでまずはおかゆを食べようと思います。
title.romaji: Kyouseiteki ni Akuyaku Reijou ni Sareteita node Mazu wa Okayu wo Tabeyou to Omoimasu.

199756.description:
My step-sister, a foreign girl named Charlotte, suddenly shows up. She may seem shy at first glance, but her hobby is... watching baseball!? I'm off to a baseball game with my step-sister Charlotte, who is a real pushover when it comes to baseball! A baseball-watching x step-brother/step-sister romantic comedy!

(Source: Comic Fuz, translated)

199758.description:
A long-awaited getaway with childhood friends takes a dangerous turn when Yu Seol-Ah wakes in the dark to a touch she shouldn’t want, only to realize it belongs to Lee Tae-Geon, her best friend’s boyfriend. Caught between sleep and reality, her body reacts before her reason can catch up, blurring lines she’s spent ten years respecting. One forbidden moment is all it takes to threaten their friendship, their trust, and perhaps...to give her everything she's ever wanted.

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

title.native: 東方幻存神籤 Whispered Oracle of Hakurei Shrine.
title.romaji: Touhou Genzonmikuji: Whispered Oracle of Hakurei Shrine.

199760.description:
Reincarnating after a life of tragedy, Shana's ready to live her best life. As the only child to a doting Duke, how hard could it be? That is until the Crown Prince claims she's his... and a handsome werewolf says only she can heal his kind! Well, time for Shana to open her (illegal) Werebeast Hospital!

(Source: Manta)
synonyms: I Opened an Illegal Veterinary Hospital in Another World
I started an illegal veterinary clinic
I Opened an Illegal Veterinary Clinic in Another World

title.english: I Opened an Illegal Werebeast Hospital

199761.description:
Ye-Bom's managed to carve out a nice little life for herself as a self-employed illustrator. Unfortunately, after having her home address revealed to a dangerous stalker, she's forced to move in with two of her childhood friends, Hyeon-Ho and Juhan. The three get along well enough, but it doesn't take long before the two guys walk in on a shocking scene in Ye-Bom's bedroom.

(Source: Tapas)

Note: Part of Metatoon's Noecheongsun Danpyeonseon (뇌청순 단편선) Collection.

199762.description:
Seong-In spent his life drawing webtoons that mocked women… until a fatal accident forced him to walk a mile in their heels. Waking up as a young woman, Seong-In thinks he’s unlocked "Life on Easy Mode," but the illusion quickly shatters. From dodging the predatory advances of a "respected" instructor to facing an marriage ultimatum from a conservative father, Seong-In must navigate a world he once ridiculed. Can Seong-In learn to reconcile the fantasy of a world catering to women and the reality of the exhausting life women face on a daily basis?

(Source: Tappytoon)

Note: Includes three extra chapters.
synonyms: This is a Work of Fiction

title.english: This is a Work of Fiction

synonyms: I’m Being Obsessed Over by the Boss Who Rejected Me
My Boss Who Rejected Me Is Now Obsessed with Me

199764.description:
Unloved and unemployed, Laeyeon's only joy in life is the mobile game "Salvation." After spending all hours playing the game, her body gives out. When she comes to, she's now Irel, a character in "Salvation." As Irel, she can now enjoy things she never had: beauty, wealth, privilege, but most of all, unconditional love from her family. However, Irel is aggressively pursued by Barkan, a cruel, and extremely violent man who asks for Irel’s hand in marriage. She knows that in the game, Irel’s family rejects Barkan’s offer to protect their daughter. This will lead to Barkan slaughtering Irel’s entire family. Now Irel must do whatever it takes to change the narrative.

(Source: Manta)
synonyms: To the One Who Will Ruin Me
To You Who Will Destroy Me

title.english: To You Who Will Ruin Me

199765.description:
Is she a villain? Or is she just...? A Chinese harem suspense story where the protagonist uses alchemy to overcome obstacles!

Byakuren, the eldest daughter of the Yanagi family, is rumored to be bullying her half-sister Mulan due to her arrogant and cold attitude, and even her maids fear her. However, this is all an act to protect her sister. Byakuren enters the harem as a candidate for queen and begins to work towards achieving a certain goal, but with the instigation of those around her, things gradually diverge from the scenario Byakuren had envisioned...

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title.native: 後宮の錬金術妃 悪の華は黄金の恋を夢見る
title.romaji: Koukyuu no Renkinjutsuhi Aku no Hana wa Ougon no Koi wo Yumemiru

199766.description:
Yoshiyama Ai, a recent graduate in her second year working as an editor, is assigned to be in charge of an novelist by a senior! While she's excited to be assigned her first author, she's also worried... The author in question is the genius Shirasagi Lily, who debuted while still in high school and has been churning out hit after hit for years. From haute couture clothes and a constant supply of expensive tea, to a palatial home: everything from food, clothing, and shelter is top-notch!
Then, one day, when Lily-sensei offers her a meal, she unexpectedly serves up a cup of... instant ramen...?

"I'm sorry... I thought you'd like it, Yoshiyama-san..." Of course, when she says that with a blush on her cheeks, she'll happily eat it!

This is a love (?) comedy that's sure to pierce your heart with the preciousness of Lily-sensei!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

Note: Includes four extra chapters.

title.native: リリー先生は仲良くなりたい

199769.description:
Once every hundred years, an imperial election is held to avert a ruinous future. Many candidates for the throne make a pledge to the saint and compete for the throne. Despite being a descendant of the first saint, Silvia, the eldest daughter of the Holy Duchy of Bernia, is oppressed by her family and the people of the territory because she lacks magical powers. However, on the night of the saint's birthday, for some reason, the holy eye resides within her, even though she should not be qualified to be a saint.

"I'll be an experimental subject!" Silvia secretly runs out of the house, and as she runs for her life, she has a fateful encounter...!?

(Source: Shueisha, translated)
synonyms: My Story Not Qualified to Be a Saint

199770.description:
The comic adaptation of the award-winning work from the Second Yuri Literary Novel Contest Yuri-Hime Award.

Note: Originally published in Comic Yuri-Hime 2020 December issue.

199771.description:
A little break from your busy days. A working cat brings you the "seeds of daily life"— sometimes useful, sometimes not— delivered gently.

(Source: Neruno Daisuki, translated)

199772.description:
Ren and Yuka are a lovey-dovey couple. But Ren, who adores his perfect girlfriend, has just one worry...that Yuka might still have feelings for her "ex-boyfriend," Saneto. With his suspicions deepening, Ren makes a certain suggestion to Yuka...

(Source: MANGA Plus)

199773.description:
The affectionate F husband, Meonggun, and the chic T wife, Nyangsuni, have completely opposite personalities, but the two who have been writing their own story as a married couple are now preparing to become a 'family of three'! The Meongnyang couple are half excited and half worried about their first pregnancy and first childbirth. From preparing for the pregnancy to the OB/GYN, postpartum care, prenatal care, preparing baby supplies, and finally, the long-awaited birth...!

We share the process of becoming parents, where nothing is easy, with all the expectant parents. Please join us in our warm daily life as we welcome a new family member!

(Source: Kakaopage, translated)

199774.description:
Yoo Seo-rin is the youngest team leader in the marketing team, and she’s headed straight for the top. Skill, looks, charm—she’s got it all and won’t slow down for anything... or anyone. Yoo Seo-rin’s love life is the only thing not going her way, especially not after her fiancé dumped her. She's sworn off men entirely, but when a handsome new rookie joins her team and makes his interest known, Yoo Seo-rin just might find herself in a man’s arms after all…

(Source: Tapas)
synonyms: Team Leader, I Will Go Straight Ahead

199775.description:
The protagonist, %%, graduated from college with a degree in chemistry, but struggled with repeated job failures. But then, an advertisement for the civil service exam appeared before his eyes. Passing in just eight months. Guaranteed retirement and a pension. And with all the benefits and the respect of those around him. For %%, the Grade 9 civil service job seemed like the perfect fit. The low pay, the high competition, and the challenging exam didn't matter to him. And so, %% embarked on the civil service exam.

(Source: Kakaopage, translated)

199776.description: Note: Published in COMIC HOTMiLK Koime Vol. 29

199777.description: Note: Published in COMIC HOTMiLK Koime Vol. 32

199778.description: Note: Published in COMIC HOTMiLK Koime Vol. 35

199779.description: Note: Published in COMIC HOTMiLK Koime Vol. 31

199780.description:
It's been 25 years since Earth was invaded by beings from another realm. Now, everyone's life is shaped by a single measure of strength—the World Ranking. From the countryside of Gunma comes Kinoko Kino, a high school girl with zero communication skills, trembling her way through city life with just one dream: to make a friend. Little does she know... she's actually the World Ranking's #1: UNKNOWN!

(Source: Shueisha, translated)
synonyms: Tokyo KINOKO: The High School Girl with the World’s Lowest Ranking Social Skills
Tokyo KINOKO: The World’s Strongest High School Girl with the Weakest Social Skills

title.native: 東京KINOKO〜世界ランキング1位のコミュ力最弱JK〜
title.romaji: Toukyou KINOKO: Sekai Ranking 1-i no Komyu-ryoku Saijaku JK

199781.description:

Moving far beyond the boundaries of traditional storytelling, this anthology dives headfirst into the lives of thrill-seekers who have utterly abandoned their moral compasses. The collection features a diverse array of taboo scenarios that explore the darkest corners of human desire and the raw electricity of forbidden encounters.

From the bittersweet yet dangerously seductive reunion with a long-lost first love to the adrenaline-fueled, illicit risks taken by a subway predator, every chapter is designed to push limits. With stunning, high-definition CG visuals that bring every scandalous detail to life, this collection invites you to witness a world of uninhibited passion and absolute deviation. Prepare yourself for an unapologetic descent into the deepest, most exhilarating depths of adult fantasy.

199921.description:
Just before dying, Princess Lillyn learns her perfect twin sister had deceived her all her life. Shocked by the betrayal, she opens her eyes to find she’s returned to childhood. This time, she's determined not to repeat her fate—and with a talking bird warning of ruin, she must fight to stay alive.

(Source: Manta)

199923.description:
Job seeker Yu Hyang-Gi, struggling day by day, one day finds herself possessed by Hyang-Dan, the character from the traditional Korean folktale Chunhyangjeon. A supporting character, not even the heroine? How wonderful! Our beautiful young lady Chunhyang, and even a madam who cares for her like her own daughter. Hyang-Dan, who only felt the warmth of family after being possessed by the novel, was enjoying a peaceful life. Until "him" showed up! The world's ultimate villain, Byun Hak-Do, is destined to harass Chunhyang and be executed by the male protagonist, Lee Mong-Ryong. How dare he look down on our Chunhyang!

"I don't know who you are, but you're a brat."
"I've been waiting."
"That's why I'm offering you this. An honor no one else can attain."

But why do you keep entangling yourself with me? Why does that man care more about me than Chunhyang?

A romantic fantasy about Hyang-Dan and Byeon Hak-Do, a twist on classic novels, Hyangdan's Tale.

(Source: Kakaopage, translated)

199924.description:
Reincarnated as Philomela, the hated character in the novel, she is doomed to die a cruel death... She has been called a fake saint, betrayed by her family and loved ones, and left with no way out. This is a fantasy of a saint who was called a fake, and whose life is turned upside down.

A series of tests from birth. Diagnosed with childhood cancer and heart disease just days after birth. This is the story of Kongi, who began life in the hospital immediately after birth, and the family who stayed by his side.

The King of Darkness and his maid...? Anna River is reborn as a character in her favorite novel "The Sacred Virgin and the King of Darkness". Will she stay a side character like she's supposed to, or will she take matters into her hands and save the infamous King of Darkness...?

Lady Demilka of the Grandched Ducal House is a flawless beauty, intelligent, and possesses an unshakably strong mind—truly the ultimate noble lady. Since childhood, she received elite education as a candidate for crown princess and never doubted she would marry into the royal family. But when the timid prince unexpectedly rejects her, she should be heartbroken... Except she's not. With perfect composure, she boldly moves to crush the broken engagement!

(Source: Comic Zenon, translated)

199932.description:
In the future, humanity builds a satellite called “the Mother” that contains all human knowledge and technology. But a war soon begins between the Empire and the Republic over control of it. One side uses AI robots, and the other uses human agents augmented with “Gaia,” a bioweapon. Reid, a top Gaia warrior, becomes a legend during the war but is reassigned to guard Spia, Speaker 52 of the Mother, after the war ends.

(Source: WEBTOON)

199933.description:
For her entire life in Joseon, Yun Jini believed there was only one man in the world, the king. As a newly appointed chambermaid guarding the royal bedchamber, she begins to awaken to forbidden desires she has never dared to name. But in a palace where love and freedom are luxuries no court lady can afford, her fate turns even darker. Accused of treason and forced to flee, Jini falls into a pond, sinking fast toward certain death.

“I don’t want to die like this!”

Her desperate plea is answered. The mysterious waters carry her not to the afterlife, but across time itself, into 21st-century Korea. Here, in a world bursting with freedom she never imagined, Jini experiences love for the very first time. Emotions long suppressed finally find release, and a woman who once knew only duty and fear begins to discover what it means to live... and to love.

(Source: Lezhin US)

Since he was a child, Yukishiro Ibuki has always had a complex of getting red-faced whenever someone gets close to him. 199950.description:
Ritsu, a real estate agent, has spent years by the side of his childhood friend Tsugumi, all the while harboring feelings he's never been able to confess. One day, he helps Tsugumi, who divorced six months ago, search for a new apartment, but unexpectedly they end up living together. At the same time, Ritsu struggles with the attention of a junior colleague who clearly has feelings for him. Then, Tsugumi suggests being his "pretend boyfriend," and what starts as a simple arrangement quickly takes an unexpected turn—!?

(Source: Shodensha, translated)

199951.description:
Leticia is reincarnated as a duke's daughter, retaining her memories of her previous life. Her three older sisters have falsely accused her of being a supporting role. One day, while Leticia was playing the supporting role as usual, for some reason, the Grand Duke of a neighboring country, Reynold, called out to her...

(Source: KADOKAWA, translated)

199954.description:
Once lauded as the best medical examiner of her team, a woman finds herself inhabiting the body of Yancy Lisbeth, a princess neglected by the matriarch for her lunacy. Now armed with the medical knowledge of her past life, she's determined to rebuild her credibility and stay in the queen's good graces. Of course, Yancy's sisters are sure to make things difficult for the newly sane princess.

(Source: Tapas)
synonyms: 皇女人设绷不住啦！（暴君皇女）
狂った皇女は天才法医学者
The Imperial Woman Can't Take it Anymore!

199956.description:
Suzumi Kirinomiya is a 36-year-old woman who doesn't live for love or money, but devotes everything to her company. 22-year-old Marumi Arashiyama joins the company where Kirinomiya works as a new employee. Arashiyama is Kirinomiya's first "student," but she is a positive junior who doesn't get discouraged even when she fails... This is a work comedy about an extremely serious boss and an extremely positive new employee.

(Source: Natalie, translated)

title.native: 部下がポジティブで泣きたい

199957.description:
When Claudia's father dies, her stepsister ensures she loses everything—her family, her home, her status—and sells her to live out the rest of her days in a squalid brothel. At her lowest point, one person reaches out to her: a ruthless marquess known across the nation as the Crimson Devil. Vowing revenge, Claudia joins hands with the marquess to rebuild her life as his wife, Luce, and seeks out revenge against her stepsister. What comes to follow is a tale of revenge that will shake the very foundations of the nation's court...

(Source: POCKETCOMICS)

title.english: Luce: My New Identity as a Contract Wife
title.native: ルーチェ～復讐のため冷酷侯爵の契約妻になります～
title.romaji: Luce: Fukushuu no Tame Reikoku Koushaku no Keiyaku Zuma ni Naramasu

199958.description:
Ella, wedded off in an arranged marriage to the Margrave Lord Oscar, found herself unloved by her husband and isolated within his manor. Her cries for help were ignored by her family as she was forced to endure the head maid’s constant torments. With Lord Oscar’s sudden death in battle, Ella is cast out of the manor in nothing more than her bedclothes. As she is on the verge of freezing to death, she catches sight of the words written in his final letter to her: “I’ve always loved you.”

But he had never shown her love, so why would he write such a thing? Suddenly waking up years in the past, Ella decides to change their fate by discovering Lord Oscar’s true feelings and fixing their married life.

In her second life, will Ella finally find Lord Oscar’s love?

(Source: POCKETCOMICS)

199960.description:
"You were the most worthy opponent I had... Farewell, Beatrice."

Sierratica Tiar Yerphinen, my sworn enemy. I died by his sword... until I didn't?!

Beatrice Shelle Marcean wakes up five years after the day of her death in a new kingdom—a new body, in a new family. She has gone from duchess to princess—and the man from her past, Sierratica Yerphinen, barges into her land to offer a treaty. He is now an emperor, seeking a bride from her new bloodline! Now living as princess Shroina, our female lead must do whatever it takes to push away from his pull. She won't repeat the same mistake twice.

(Source: Pocket Comics)

Note: First released in English, with the initial eligible release in Japanese followed by Korean, making it a manga by our standards.

title.native: 愛してはいけない宿敵

199961.description:
Lydie, imprisoned for being labeled a witch, is unexpectedly rescued by a mysterious wizard named Victor. He uses his magic to transport her to a secluded island in the north, a haven for witches and wizards. With Victor's guidance, Lydie begins to carve out her place within the island's community. However, just as she starts to grapple with her burgeoning feelings for Victor, he inexplicably begins to pull away. Lydie has finally found a place where she belongs, but could Victor's undisclosed plans jeopardize everything...?

(Source: POCKETCOMICS)

199967.description:
200 years ago, the Great Demon Prelude was sealed by a legendary hero. Now awakened, he seeks out a girl named Freesia—who looks exactly like the hero—and asks her to die. But then he finds out that she's only 20. As his plan to regain his power by eating her, Prelude ends up as her… personal housekeeper?!

(Source: Manta)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

title.english: It's Only You That I Want

199968.description:
If he didn't touch her constantly, she would die. Thus, Lyret's fate was sealed when Duke Balderion's name engraving suddenly appeared on her skin. Yet, he's the one who killed her traitorous father and cast her into ruin. Can Lyret escape the Duke and his smouldering glare?

(Source: Manta)

199969.description:
In a Bulgarian village under Ottoman rule during the 16th century, a young girl named Luca endures a life of mistreatment at the hands of her adoptive family, finding her only refuge under the protection of her adoptive brother, Lev. However, one day, soldiers from the Imperial army arrive on a hunt for young boys—and Lev is taken away. Thus begins the fateful tale of two souls, bound by a solemn vow to reunite!

(Source: Akita Shoten, translated)

199970.description:
An upbeat adventure tale about a Reiwa Gal and a boy from the End of the Edo Period.

199972.description:
As the country's top court magician, the strong and handsome Oswald attracts attention from those around him. However, one day, while protecting his fiancée, the saint, from a magical beast, he is injured and loses both his good looks and magical powers. The saint then informs him that she has unilaterally broken off their engagement and is offering her younger sister, Chelsea, as his new fiancée. Chelsea devotes herself to Oswald, but there are rumors that she is being oppressed by the saint and that she harbors a secret...

This is a love fantasy about a court magician and a troubled young lady.

(Source: Natalie, translated)

title.native: 聖女の身代わりとしてやってきた婚約者殿の様子がおかしい
title.romaji: Seijo no Migawari to Shite Yatte Kita Konyakusha-dono no Yousu ga Okashii

199973.description:
After being betrayed by her co-worker boyfriend and her sister, Suzumi runs away from home and her company. By chance, she visits Fuu, a gold repair craftsman who used to live with her deceased brother. Her encounter with Fuu, who makes a living by repairing broken ceramics with gold repair, helps her to rebuild her shattered feelings and life.

(Source: Natalie, translated)

199974.description:
"From today, you belong to me."

Born into a family of shrine maidens, Kotoko possesses little spiritual power. Compared to her more accomplished twin sister, she is bullied by those around her as a "failed shrine maiden." One day, disaster strikes the village. To avert the village's crisis, her parents decide to offer Kotoko, an "unwanted child," as a sacrifice to the ruthless fox god. For the sake of the village, Kotoko accepts her role. However, when the fox god Kannagi appears, he announces that he will make her his companion...

The unfortunate girl is offered to the god and learns about love. A Japanese-style fantasy of doting love woven together by a fateful encounter!

(Source: Cmoa Comics, translated)

199980.description:
Every year in this country, a "Lady Ranking" is held, where young ladies are ranked and the most beautiful and intelligent lady is given the goddess's blessing. Meriel Forster, the daughter of a duke, is the granddaughter of Beatrice, the legendary saint who inspired the ranking, but she falls outside the top of the rankings. A plain and shy girl, she is dejected after her fiancé, the second prince, breaks off their engagement. Beatrice calls out to Meriel, but a certain incident causes the two to switch minds...

This is an exhilarating love fantasy in which Beatrice gets revenge on those who mocked her.

(Source: Natalie, translated)

199981.description:
A knight and a songstress whose love once ended tragically are reincarnated, through the pity of God, into a beautiful world where flowers heal people's wounds. Char, a young "flower guardian" who protects people from flower-eating monsters known as "flower eaters," one day has a fateful reunion with Lena, the reincarnation of the songstress he loved in his past life.

Char recalls his memories of his past life, but Lena has no recollection of them. Entrusting their frustrating feelings to the language of flowers, the two gradually begin to connect with each other, but... The despair of Char's past life casts a dark shadow over them both.

This is a pure love fantasy set in another world, in which a clumsy knight and a cheerful former songstress are guided by flowers to weave their love once again.

(Source: forcs, translated)

title.native: 君と花 ～亡国の歌姫と騎士は転生して再び巡り逢う～

199983.description:
Kagara Sosuke, the heir to a distinguished family, was born with everything people envy, but he had an arrogant and twisted personality. One snowy day, while on a boring outing as instructed by his parents, Sosuke came across a dying girl lying on the side of the road. On a whim, Sosuke saved the girl from being kidnapped by a homeless man, but the girl he saved showed no gratitude or fear; she simply remained expressionless.

"I wonder what her face will look like if I make her cry."

Driven by a twisted curiosity, Sosuke took the girl home and began to educate her himself. Before long, the girl grew into such an accomplished attendant that she became the talk of the town. This is a romantic story that begins with the twisted relationship between an arrogant master and an expressionless orphan.

(Source: forcs, translated)

title.native: 俺とひなどり～クズ御曹司が捨て子を拾ったら～

199984.description:
When Ju-ah entered the work force, she was expecting her days to be hard and long…but much to her surprise (and pleasure), that’s not the only thing! Surrounded by three hot bosses who know what they’re doing both in the office and bedroom, this rookie’s first job is bound to be much more unique than most!

(Source: Lezhin US)
synonyms: Going to a Workshop with My Bosses

199985.description:
Selah Cardi is a former marine biology student who woke up in a romance novel as an inconsequential extra. Eager to survive the plot, Selah manages to rescue Maria so that she and Duke Herbert, her fiancé, will be indebted to her. But then Admiral Ellaim notices her and her magical abilities that allow her to breathe underwater. Selah soon discovers that Ellaim is a merman called a siren, and that he needs her powers to recover from a mysterious illness. Will her dream of retiring by the sea in peace ever come true?

(Source: WEBTOON)

199987.description:
“Mr. Vamp,” an immortal vampire, has had a number of careers over his long life. To mix things up, he's now working as a history teacher in a high school in Japan. He thinks he's got everyone fooled into believing he's just an ordinary mortal, but due to a lack of effort on his part when it comes to truly blending in, the students and teachers all realize his true nature (but still humor him by going along with the fiction). Hijinks ensue!

(Source: Kodansha USA)

199989.description:
After diligently practicing "wall ball," Bungo Ishihama meets Yukio Noda, a member of Japan's youth baseball national team in a fateful encounter. The two then advance to middle school and join the ultra-competitive "Seio Senior" team. Aiming for the top of middle school baseball, they engage in fierce battles! As time passes, the duo moves on to high school, setting their sights on achieving "five consecutive Koshien championships," once again striving for the top!

(Source: MANGA Plus)

199993.description:
What if you could actually use a mouse cursor in real life? Takumi, the nerdy outcast, harbors unrequited feelings for his first love, Mone, who treats him with disdain. During computer class, Takumi discovers that his mouse cursor extends beyond the screen and into the physical world...?! With this newfound power visible only to him, Takumi sees an opportunity for mischief. He uses the cursor to get revenge on Mone, clicking on sensitive areas and reveling in her reactions. But when an "Intercourse" button appears unexpectedly, Takumi is thrust into a reality he never imagined possible..."Intercourse"?! Could this really be...?!

(Source: Coolmic)

199994.description:
Eight has been forced to fight in an arena as a slave day by day for as long as she can remember. One day, however, all of that changed when a garrison of troops staged a raid on the arena, led by a Dragonkin named Celeste. In the frantic fighting and fleeing, Eight is seen fighting against her master... and in that moment Celeste realizes that he has found his destined partner... his mate.

(Source: MangaPlaza)

199999.description:
A girl named Nona lives in plain sight among humans, hiding her true identity as a mage as she spends her days in peace with her best friend Lovi. But one day, Nona uses magic to fix Lovi's glasses and subsequently catches the attention of the Bureau of Magic Surveillance. A simple good deed becomes the trigger that sets Nona's destiny in motion...
